title: Executivo Comercial Hunter - Grandes Contas - Mercado Pago | Natal, RN.
description:
No Mercado Livre estamos democratizando o comércio e os serviços financeiros para transformar a vida das pessoas na América Latina. Faça parte deste propósito!


Nosso negócio Fintech oferece para toda a região uma proposta de valor integral, que visa democratizar os serviços financeiros e satisfazer as necessidades de mais de 60 milhões de usuários e usuárias.

Disponibilizamos uma plataforma online que permite receber pelas vendas eletrônicas realizadas, tanto dentro como fora do Mercado Livre, e um sistema de códigos QR e dispositivos Point para as vendas realizadas no mundo físico, para milhões de comerciantes, empreendedores e profissionais, damos a possibilidade de processar suas operações com segurança, através de mais de 50 meios de pagamento na América Latina.

Além disso, fornecemos acesso gratuito a uma conta digital que permite pagar, enviar e receber dinheiro, gerar renda e trabalhar com cartões para fazer compras ou saques. Através do Mercado Crédito, concedemos créditos para satisfazer as necessidades daqueles a quem prestamos nossos serviços e potencializar os negócios de quem vende através da nossa plataforma.



Temos um desafio para as pessoas que:

  • Vibram energia empreendedora: são movidas pela curiosidade, nunca desistem e estão focadas em superar seus próprios limites.
  • Dão o máximo, porque adoram trabalhar com compromisso e dedicação.
  • Encaram as mudanças como oportunidades e aprendem com seus erros.
  • A excelência e a execução são primordiais na sua forma de fazer as coisas.
  • Promovem o bom clima, a alegria e a diversão.
  • Sabem como construir com outras pessoas e desfrutam trabalhando em equipe.



Imagine você empreendendo projetos desafiadores, dinâmicos e inovadores, e sendo responsável por:


  • Prospectar ativamente novos clientes com o perfil de Grandes Contas.
  • Atuar de forma consultiva, compreendendo as dores e oportunidades dos clientes para propor soluções completas de valor agregado ao negócio.
  • Gerir todo o funil de vendas, desde a prospecção até o fechamento e onboarding do cliente sendo usuário modelo dos sistemas da companhia.
  • Sustentar relacionamentos estratégicos com clientes e parceiros de negócio e monitorar tendências de mercado, comportamento da concorrência e oportunidades de crescimento para a sua região de atuação.
  • Trabalhar em sinergia com equipes de produtos e operações para garantir a melhor entrega ao cliente.
  • Ser consultivo para atuar no detalhe durante as negociações sobre os serviços financeiros do Mercado Pago, Meios de Pagamento e Software de Gestão.



Requisitos:


  • Possuir graduação completa.
  • Ter experiência na prospecção de clientes para grandes contas no sesgmento de meios de pagamento.
  • Contar com experiência sólida em vendas consultivas B2B nos segmentos de serviços financeiros, adquirência ou meios de pagamento.
  • Possuir vivência comercial em cenários de metas.
  • Possuir disponibilidade para trabalho presencial.
  • Possuir carro próprio.



Nós lhe propomos:

  • Ser parte de uma empresa com espírito empreendedor, na qual adoramos pensar grande e em longo prazo.
  • Ser protagonista de seu desenvolvimento em um ambiente de oportunidades, aprendizagem, crescimento, expansão e projetos desafiadores.
  • Compartilhar e aprender em equipe, com excelentes profissionais e especialistas.
  • Um excelente clima de trabalho, com todo o necessário para você viver uma grande experiência. :)



O Mercado Livre não faz contato oferecendo oportunidades em troca de pagamento de dinheiro. Você tem acesso a todas as oportunidades abertas no nosso site de carreiras. Caso receba pedidos de dinheiro, desconfie!

title: Business English Teacher
description:
Job Description


Title: Transform the Future of Brazilian Executives with Your English Knowledge!


Do you believe in the power of communication to open doors and transform lives? At YouAble, we help Brazilian executives overcome language barriers and conquer their place in the global market. We are now looking for dedicated teachers to be part of this mission.


What we offer:

  • R$ 60 per hour of class (contractor model), with an average of 25 weekly 30 or 60-minute classes.
  • 100% remote work.
  • Flexible hours, with classes distributed between mornings and evenings (7 AM - 1 PM and 5 PM - 10 PM, Brasília time).

    • What we're looking for in you:

    • Fluent or native English.
    • Experience in the corporate world to understand the real needs of students.
    • Adaptability and creativity to personalize classes according to each professional's profile.

    • Your role at YouAble:

    • Teach individual and small group online classes.
    • Closely monitor the evolution of each student, ensuring concrete results.

title: Pessoa  Team Lead
description:
Principais atribuições e entregas contínuas do cargo:

● Conduzir rituais (planning, review, retro), realizar 1:1s, dar feedbacks e gerir desempenho.

● Contratar, onboarding e desenvolver o time (PDI, mentoring, trilhas).

● Co-planejar roadmap com PM e desdobrar em OKRs/KPIs e metas claras.

● Garantir previsibilidade: gestão de escopo, riscos, dependências e comunicação com stakeholders.

● Liderança técnica do squad: padrões, revisão de código, desenho de soluções, RFCs leves; escalar arquitetura ampla quando necessário.

● Elevar práticas: testes automatizados, CI/CD, observabilidade e segurança/LGPD.

● Gestão de incidentes: on-call, runbooks, RCA e follow-ups.

● Acompanhar e melhorar DORA (lead time, deployment frequency, change failure rate, MTTR) e SLO/SLI.

● FinOps básico: visibilidade e otimização de custos de nuvem.

● Promover cultura AI-First (automação, opilots) com responsabilidade.


Competências Técnicas:

● Stack: .NET Core, C#, Angular, MySQL, Redis, RabbitMQ, Docker, Kubernetes, AWS.

● Boas práticas: arquitetura modular, testes, CI/CD, observabilidade (logs/métricas/traces), segurança (LGPD, OWASP, gestão de segredos).

● Métricas e operação: OKRs/KPIs, DORA, SLO/SLI, incident response.

● Diferenciais: pagamentos/antifraude, experimentação (feature flags/A-B), Team Topologies, SRE. ● Disponibilidade para atuar no fuso BRT (±2).

● Participação em on-call quando necessário.

● Inglês técnico para leitura/colaboração.


Competências Comportamentais:

● Tomada de decisão com trade-offs explícitos.

● Mentalidade data-informed e orientação a clientes.

● Habilidade de coaching/mentoria e desenvolvimento de carreira do time.

● Ownership, senso de urgência e foco em resultados.


Experiências Desejadas:

● Tipos de vivências profissionais que aceleram a curva de aprendizado e performance.

● Atuação relevante em engenharia de software (backend/fullstack), participando de decisões arquiteturais e entregas de alta complexidade técnica.

● Experiência na condução de times multidisciplinares, sendo responsável por metas, performance e evolução do time.

title: PESSOA COORDENADORA DE CIÊNCIA DE DADOS - REMOTO
description:
Descrição da vaga

A SOMOS Educação é um dos principais grupos de educação básica do Brasil, oferecendo uma ampla variedade de soluções educacionais. Nossos serviços incluem sistemas de ensino, editoras, soluções de ensino complementares e uma plataforma tecnológica de aprendizado digital e e-commerce. Com isso, nos apresentamos como parceiros integrais das escolas.


Entre as marcas que compõem o nosso grupo estão Anglo, PH, Plurall, Líder em Mim e outras. Nossa missão é transformar o ecossistema das escolas privadas, combinando educação e gestão de alta qualidade com base na neurociência e na tecnologia em larga escala. Além disso, buscamos liderar as escolas no processo de transformação digital, visando ser o principal agente de reinvenção da educação para o aluno e a escola do século XXI.


Para cumprir essa missão e entregar o melhor para as nossas escolas, baseamos nosso trabalho em valores fundamentais. Valorizamos a autonomia e o apoio, o bem-estar, a excelência, a liderança e a inovação em nossa rotina de trabalho. Somos o único grupo educacional classificado como uma das Melhores Empresas para se trabalhar, Great Place to Work – GPTW.



Responsabilidades e atribuições:

- Coordenar a equipe de tecnologia, garantindo a qualidade e integridade das informações;

- Realizar análise de dados, utilizando técnicas de Business Intelligence e Data Mining;

- Gerenciar o banco de dados e implementar soluções de Big Data;

- Liderar projetos de análise de dados e extração de insights;

- Resolver problemas relacionados à manipulação e interpretação de dados;

- Promover a comunicação eficaz entre a equipe e demais áreas da empresa.




Requisitos e qualificações:

- Graduação em Ciência da Computação

- Pós-graduação em Análise de Dados

- Certificação em Big Data

title: English Teacher
description:
Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!

Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good WiFi, a webcam, and a microphone.


If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach!

Whether you’re looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we’ve got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.


What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at LatinHire?

You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.

If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.

When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!


In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with LatinHire:


  • Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!
  • You be your own boss and set your own schedule
  • Work from anywhere (as long as you have good WiFi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone).
  • Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month.


Minimum Requirements:


  • Portuguese as a first language.
  • C1 or C2 Level English Speaker
  • University degree in English Teaching or related area.
  • One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language.
  • Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2MB) internet connection.
  • Must pass a criminal background check.
  • Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability.


Who we are:

Established in 2003, LatinHire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

title: Founding Engineer
description:
About Able

Able is the AI front office for Wholesale Plumbing, HVAC, and Electrical Suppliers. We're automating the soul-crushing manual work that buries inside sales teams - starting with fixture quoting.


The Wholesale Supply market is a $350B+ market running on spreadsheets and tribal knowledge. We're building the infrastructure to change that.


About the Role

Founding Engineer, with a focus on shipping Agents. You'll spec features, debug weird edge cases, scale infrastructure and help us figure out what to build next based on what customers actually need.

We're not looking for someone who needs a roadmap handed to them. We're looking for somebody who wants to help build the roadmap. If you see a problem, you fix it. If you don't know something, you learn it.


What we're looking for

  • 3 to 5 years of Software Engineering experience
  • Backend depth — you're comfortable owning a Python/FastAPI service end-to-end, from async request handling to data modeling to production debugging
  • Agent & LLM Fluent - you understand how agentic systems work and the failure modes that arise
  • Cloud comfortable - GCP, Firestore, Pub/Sub, Vercel, & Docker. You don't need to be an infra specialist but you shouldn't be scared of it
  • Document intelligence - comfortable working with document parsing & extraction pipelines (OCR, layout analysis, structured extraction, etc)


You're Likely a Fit If

  • You've designed, built, and shipped something with LLMs or Agents with real users
  • You're comfortable making decisions and backing up your logic
  • You default to shipping over planning. Iteration > Perfection
  • You've worked in an early-stage company before and are ready for the chaos
  • You're a tinkerer - also playing around with new technologies or projects


What You'll Do

  • Work with the Founding team to collect user feedback, design feature specs, implement updates, and deploy to production
  • Work across the stack: Python/FastAPI, Next.js/Typescript, Firebase, Docker, GCP, etc
  • Debug production issues and make them obsolete
  • Build and improve agent workflows using home grown frameworks
  • Help shape the product roadmap
  • Stay up to date on modern agent architectures/improvements and implement where
  • necessary


Want some Bonus Points?

We've set up an MCP server at ` - candidates who know what to do with it will find something useful

title: College-Level Chemistry Tutor
description:
We are looking for tutors to solve college-level Chemistry questions in English. These questions are submitted by students, who expect a response in less than 24 hours.


Tutors in this project work in freelance mode and can decide the number of hours they wish to work.


Do you prefer to work in the morning, in the evening, for a few hours or many hours? The choice is yours. You can log in at any time to help students. In addition, you can work from anywhere, as long as you have a computer with a reliable Internet connection.


We need tutors who can start immediately!


Characteristics


Payment in dollars.

Type of contract: freelance/self-employed.

Schedule: Flexible, free choice

Requirements

  • Computer with an Internet connection.
  • No criminal record.

title: Senior Frontend Developer
description:
Company Description

Empregos.com.br is one of Brazil's premier job and career platforms, connecting professionals with employment opportunities and providing career guidance and training. With over 180,000 job offers from 80,000 companies and a database of more than 1 million resumes, the platform serves as a key resource for job seekers and employers. The service is free for companies to post job openings or search for candidates, aiding in creating meaningful connections in the job market. Empregos.com.br is committed to bridging the gap between talent and opportunity in Brazil.


Role Description

We are looking for a Mid-Level or Senior Frontend Developer to work directly on building and evolving our digital products.


What you will do on a daily basis:

Develop and enhance frontend applications using Vue.js and Nuxt.js

Work with SSR (Server-Side Rendering), technical SEO, and web performance

Consume and integrate REST APIs

Continuously improve Core Web Vitals and search engine indexation

Participate in technical decisions and frontend architecture evolution

Work in agile cycles, with frequent deliveries and constant feedback

Collaborate closely with Product, Design, and Backend teams to deliver high-impact solutions


What we expect from you:

Solid experience with Vue.js and/or Nuxt.js

SEO is not a plus — it’s mandatory (rendering, indexing, performance)

Experience consuming Web APIs

Experience with CI/CD pipelines

Experience with Docker containers

Strong knowledge of Git

Ability to translate design into pixel-perfect, high-performance interfaces

Agile mindset: prioritization, short delivery cycles, and continuous improvement


Nice to have:


Experience working on high-traffic projects

Strong knowledge of frontend performance optimization

Previous experience with SEO-driven products


What we offer:


100% remote work

Technical autonomy and space for decision-making

A product with real impact and scale

A collaborative environment where we learn and grow together

Contractor agreement (PJ)


If you enjoy solving real problems, working at scale, optimizing SEO and performance, and growing alongside a living product, this opportunity is for you!

title: Senior Applied Scientist (AI/ML - Inbound Team)
description:
Senior Applied Scientist – AI/ML Customer Science (Remote – Brazil)


Location: 100% Remote (Brazil)

Employment Type: PJ – Long term


About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Applied Scientist to design, develop, and deploy advanced machine learning, causal inference, and optimization systems that drive Marketing and Sales decision-making.

In this role, you will transform complex customer behavior and business growth challenges into measurable objectives and scalable ML solutions across acquisition, conversion, retention, and revenue optimization.

You will work at the intersection of machine learning, experimentation, causal inference, and business strategy in a fast-paced, collaborative, and entrepreneurial environment.


What You’ll Work On

You will build models and platforms that create impact across areas such as:

  • Sales prioritization and expected value modeling
  • Marketing targeting and uplift modeling
  • Multi-touch attribution and incrementality measurement
  • Customer lifecycle modeling (conversion, retention, churn, LTV)
  • Outreach optimization and personalization systems


Responsibilities

  • Research, design, and develop machine learning, statistical, and causal models for Marketing and Sales use cases including:
  • Propensity and expected value modeling
  • Uplift and treatment effect estimation
  • Attribution and marketing measurement
  • Forecasting, optimization, and prioritization systems
  • Translate business growth problems into clear objectives, loss functions, and evaluation frameworks
  • Design feature representations capturing customer behavior, engagement, and lifecycle dynamics
  • Design and analyze experiments (A/B tests, geo tests, incrementality tests, diff-in-diff, causal impact)
  • Build and maintain robust evaluation frameworks aligned with business outcomes (ROI, CAC, conversion, retention, LTV)
  • Own the end-to-end ML lifecycle: data ingestion, feature engineering, training, deployment, monitoring
  • Develop scalable ML services integrated into business workflows (CRM, marketing platforms, internal tools)
  • Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Marketing, Sales, and Data teams
  • Influence technical direction and roadmap prioritization based on business impact
  • Clearly communicate insights and model behavior to technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Mentor junior scientists and engineers and help establish best practices
  • Contribute to long-term data science strategy, platforms, and innovation


Minimum Qualifications

  • 5+ years of industry experience in applied Machine Learning
  • Master’s degree or PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Statistics, Operations Research, or related field
  • 3+ years of experience building, deploying, and managing ML models in production at scale
  • Strong knowledge of ML best practices (feature engineering, experimentation, pipelines, model evaluation)
  • Experience with modern ML techniques including gradient boosting, deep learning, transformers, and optimization
  • Experience in Computer Vision (Causal Inference experience is a strong plus)
  • Proficiency in Python and SQL
  • Hands-on experience with ML frameworks: PyTorch, TensorFlow, Keras, Scikit-learn
  • Strong data engineering skills with large-scale datasets
  • Experience with big data tools such as Apache Beam, Kafka, Spark
  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure)


Preferred Qualifications

  • PhD in CS, ML, AI, Statistics, Operations Research, or related field
  • Experience applying ML in retail or commercial business contexts
  • Familiarity with MLOps tools and production pipelines
  • Strong leadership and mentoring experience
  • Impact-driven mindset with a focus on delivering high-quality, scalable solutions

title: Especialista em Chatbot
description:
Vaga para modelo de contratação PJ


Remoto | PJ | R$6.000/mês


Estamos buscando um(a) Especialista em Chatbot com forte visão de experiência do cliente, conversão e otimização de jornada para evoluir nosso principal canal conversacional: WhatsApp + Chatbot .

Procuramos alguém que vá além da automação técnica e consiga transformar fricções reais da operação, dúvidas recorrentes e gargalos de atendimento em melhorias estruturadas e escaláveis no produto conversacional.

Se você vem de atendimento, Customer Success, operações, growth, CRM ou marketing orientado à conversão, essa vaga pode ter alto fit com seu perfil.


Responsabilidades principais:

  • Mapear, estruturar e evoluir fluxos conversacionais do chatbot
  • Identificar gargalos, fricções e pontos de abandono na jornada
  • Propor melhorias estratégicas em:
  • Copy e mensagens
  • Sequência lógica dos fluxos
  • Microconversões
  • CTAs
  • Criar, organizar e priorizar o backlog de melhorias do chatbot
  • Trabalhar em parceria com time técnico para implementação
  • Categorizar dúvidas recorrentes e organizar intents
  • Estruturar documentação oficial dos fluxos
  • Apoiar e executar testes A/B de mensagens e estruturas
  • Conectar aprendizados da operação com evolução do produto


Métricas sob responsabilidade

  • Conversão por etapa
  • Taxa de abandono por fluxo
  • Volume de interações
  • Taxa de resolução automática
  • Tempo médio de jornada

title: Analista de Compliance (Jr)
description:
Somos protagonistas na transformação digital dos meios de pagamento, somos a HST!

Desvendamos os desafios mais complexos e desde a nossa fundação temos a missão de tornar as transações eletrônicas mais seguras.


Estamos presentes em +20 Países e, dentre os nossos Clientes, estão os 8 Bancos mais importantes do Brasil e os 20 da América Latina!


São +80.000 terminais de autoatendimento; +1.000.000 autenticações de transações de compras eletrônicas ao mês; +800.000 cartões bancários com chip disponibilizados ao mês em lojas e agências bancárias; e até em 2024, foram +100 bancos utilizando nossos sistemas de emissor que permitem a tokenização de cartões COF (Card on File) e eCommerce. Isso é só uma parte dos nossos resultados, mas também é só começo!

Nos bastidores de todas as nossas conquistas está o nosso Time, que conta com +200 Pessoas envolvidas no desenvolvimento das nossas soluções. Pessoas questionadoras, curiosas, criativas, proativas, colaborativas e abertas a novas experiências!

Para saber mais sobre a HST e sobre as nossas oportunidades, acesse:


Buscamos uma pessoa Analista de Compliance (Jr) para se unir ao nosso Time de Compliance para:

  • Atualização de documentos requeridos pela certificação (Evidências de que os requerimentos PCI estão sendo cumpridos), visando conclusão do processo de auditoria de forma rápida e precisa;
  • Realização de atividades decorrentes das certificações das bandeiras (Visa, Mastercard e outros), visando cumprir com o exigido pela norma;
  • Auxílio na verificação da integridade de artefatos durante a fase inicial do projeto de certificação, a fim de reduzir desvios e atividades não previstas no curso do projeto;
  • Participação de projetos de certificação, interagindo com empresa terceira que realiza a auditoria, visando desembaraçar quaisquer entraves identificados no decorrer do projeto;
  • Organização de artefatos providos pelos círculos durante o projeto de certificação, visando manter uma base íntegra e rastreável de evidências;
  • Acompanhamento de reuniões técnicas com as demais áreas para discussão de temas referentes a evolução dos produtos;
  • Auxílio na execução dos treinamentos. (PCI, Segurança da Informação, LGPD e outros);
  • Disseminação das políticas e procedimentos de segurança HST;
  • Execução de processo de gestão de vulnerabilidades com os demais círculos envolvidos, visando elevar a segurança em todos os serviços e produtos da HST;
  • Execução de simulações de resposta a incidentes e continuidade de negócios, visando manter a resiliência da empresa em situações adversas.


Acreditamos ser importante que você já tenha passado por algumas experiências e que também tenha os seguintes conhecimentos:

  • Formação completa em cursos relacionados à tecnologia;
  • Conhecimento básico em certificação PCI;
  • Conhecimento básico em normas de proteção de dados pessoais (LGPD);
  • Inglês intermediário;
  • Espanhol básico;
  • Conhecimento com produtos, ou com os conceitos relacionados com meios de pagamento.


O que oferecemos?

A HST é uma empresa certificada GPTW! Oferecemos a oportunidade de crescimento em um ambiente de desafios em que a contrapartida de cada Pessoa equivale ao tamanho da sua vontade de crescer !

  • Contratação em regime CLT;
  • Atuação 100% Remota;
  • Horário flexível;
  • Oportunidade de crescimento, através do contínuo desenvolvimento, tanto técnico quanto pessoal;
  • Temos programas de desenvolvimento destinado às novas lideranças;
  • 10% das horas mensais, podem ser dedicadas para aprender algo novo;
  • Day-Off no mês do aniversário;
  • Ajuda de Custo Home Office;
  • Licença Maternidade e Paternidade Ampliadas;
  • Participação nos Lucros e Resultados;
  • WellHub (antiga Gympass);
  • Convênio médico;
  • Convênio odontológico;
  • Vale Alimentação/Refeição;
  • Vale Transporte ou estacionamento;
  • Auxílio Creche;
  • Seguro de Vida.


Prezamos por um bom ambiente de trabalho que contribua para as pessoas evoluírem e se sentirem acolhidas, livres, autênticas e à vontade para demonstrarem suas habilidades! Apoiamos a diversidade e não temos espaço para qualquer tipo de discriminação!

title: UI/UX Designer (Part-Time)
description:
We are looking for a part-time, remote UI/UX Designer with 6+ years in UI/UX or Product Design to to partner closely with the Product and Engineering teams to elevate usability, visual consistency, and user experience across the platforms of our U.S. client. You will work 10 hours per week in a hands-on role supporting new feature design, workflow improvements, and visual system enhancements across the SaaS products. The ideal candidate is comfortable working in B2B software environments, translating product requirements into thoughtful user experiences, and collaborating with crossfunctional teams.

Our client provides a cloud-based ERP platform to hundreds of energy industry customers delivering market-leading field service management, field data gathering, transportation, production, accounting, and land software solutions. Backed by private equity, our client accelerates business performance, improves operational efficiency, and reduces costs.


Responsibilities

  • Design intuitive user experiences for complex SaaS workflows and data-heavy applications
  • Create wireframes, prototypes, and high-fidelity UI designs
  • Partner with Product Managers and Engineers to shape feature concepts and interaction patterns
  • Apply and extend existing design systems and component libraries
  • Conduct lightweight user research or usability testing when needed
  • Iterate quickly based on stakeholder feedback and technical constraints
  • Ensure designs align with accessibility and usability best practices
  • Prepare assets and specs for smooth handoff to engineering


Requirements

  • Excellent English communication and interpersonal skills
  • 6+ years in UI/UX or Product Design, with significant experience in B2B SaaS or enterprise software
  • Strong portfolio showcasing end-to-end design work on data-intensive systems (dashboards, tables, grids, reporting tools, multi-step workflows)
  • Experience designing for multi-role environments with interconnected user workflows
  • Experience collaborating closely with product and engineering to navigate technical constraints and trade-offs
  • Proficiency with design tools
  • Familiarity with design systems and component-driven product development
  • Ability to work independently within a limited-hours engagement
  • Clear communicator who can explain design decisions to technical and non-technical partners


Desired Expereince

  • Bachelors degree in computer science or engineering
  • Experience in energy, finance, accounting, or other regulated/operational industries


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Lets learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

  • We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent that enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Analista de Controladoria SR
description:
Assessoramos importante empresa na contratação de um Analista de Controladoria Sr.

Resumo da Posição:

O analista de controladoria sênior é o profissional responsável pela análise do desempenho financeiro, elaboração de relatórios gerenciais da área, elaborar o planejamento do budget e forecast, monitorar indicadores da área, apoiar a diretoria em análises e tomada de decisões que envolvam impactos financeiros, sempre visando os objetivos da empresa. É responsável por garantir a saúde financeira dos processos e projetos da empresa, identificar oportunidades de melhorias e otimizar procedimentos e controles internos.

Principais responsabilidades:

Fechamento contábil:

  • Revisão e validação de todos os lançamentos contábeis da empresa;
  • Interface com contabilidade e áreas operacionais para esclarecimento de variações ou inconsistências;
  • Apurar resultados gerenciais, analisar variações, gerar relatórios e apoiar decisões.

Relatórios:

  • Consolidar os dados financeiros e operacionais, incluindo elaboração do Balanço Patrimonial e DRE (realizado vs. orçado vs. forecast);
  • Realizar relatórios gerenciais, orçamentários, indicadores financeiros gerais e relatórios de fechamento;
  • Estudo de variações, identificação de causas, geração de insights financeiros;
  • Envio de relatórios mensais à matriz.

Planejamento financeiro:

  • Definição de dados relevantes;
  • Elaboração, revisão e suporte na construção de todo planejamento financeiro de curto, médio e longo prazo;
  • Organização de dados financeiros de áreas diferentes;
  • Análise de dados de acordo com modelos e cenários diferentes;
  • Alinhamento com o planejamento estratégico da empresa;
  • Atualização de previsões;
  • Apresentação para a diretoria e elaboração de planos de ação.

Gestão orçamentária:

  • Gestão do planejamento e orçamento;
  • Monitorar execução do planejamento, apontando desvios e suportando na construção dos devidos planos de ações;
  • Identificar e analisar variações real x orçado.

Apoio à liderança:

  • Elaboração de relatórios financeiros relevantes para cada área;
  • Esclarecimento de dúvidas da diretoria e fornecimento de insumos para a tomada de decisões.


Requisitos


  • Formação em Administração, Contabilidade, Economia ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência consolidada em controladoria e planejamento financeiro.
  • Domínio de Excel avançado; rotinas em ERP;
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de automação será um diferencial.
  • Capacidade analítica, visão estratégica e atenção a detalhes.
  • Inglês avançado.

title: Email Graphic Designer
description:
About Lilo Social

Lilo Social is a full-funnel eCommerce growth agency specializing in acquisition and retention for direct-to-consumer brands. With a team of over 75 professionals, we deliver best-in-class paid media, email marketing, and creative services to help brands scale profitably. We work across the entire customer lifecycle—from content creation and paid advertising to conversion rate optimization and retention marketing.


Our partnership-first approach has earned us a 90% client retention rate and recognition as an Inc. 5000 honoree for three consecutive years (2023, 2024, 2025). We are proud to be a Klaviyo Master Elite Agency, a distinction held by only 0.2% of Klaviyo's 6,500+ partners. To date, we have driven billions of dollars in attributed revenue for our partners.


The Role

title: Dev. Java + AWS (Projeto Internacional)
description:
Se você busca uma oportunidade na área de Tecnologia da Informação, tem organização, boa comunicação e vontade de crescer, essa vaga 100% remoto e CLT, pode ser para você.


Requisitos Técnicos:

  • Experiência sólida com Java e que possui conhecimentos em AWS.
  • Experiência com CI/CD, (Kubernetes / Jenkins / Docker) será um diferencial.
  • Experiência com banco de dados;
  • Idioma Inglês Avançado (terá inteirações internacionais).


Responsabilidades:

Esse profissional será responsável por provisionar, configurar e manter ambientes em nuvem, utilizando ferramentas para garantir escalabilidade, estabilidade e segurança dos sistemas.

O profissional também atuará no suporte operacional, realizando análises de erros e troubleshooting, assegurando que os ambientes estejam corretamente logados, monitorados e performando de forma eficiente. Ter conhecimento ou interesse em práticas de CI/CD é valorizado, assim como disposição para trabalhar com ferramentas correlatas.

Buscamos alguém com perfil proativo, analítico e orientado à automação, que contribua ativamente para a melhoria contínua dos processos e da infraestrutura


O que oferecemos:

  • Ambiente colaborativo e multicultural.
  • Oportunidade de desenvolvimento profissional em uma das líderes globais em tecnologia.
  • Pacote de benefícios completo - PLR, VR, Gympass, Previdência, Convênios, etc.

We are currently inviting qualified ESL teachers to apply for a remote instructional role supporting international learners through our structured online teaching platform.

This is a contract-based teaching position offering self-managed scheduling within a professional global education environment.


Why Join Us

·      Remote teaching structure

title: Executive Search Consultant
description:
About Gold & Aron:

Gold & Aron Conseil is a boutique executive search firm with a 20+ year track record of placing top-tier talent in the Technology and Financial Services industries across the Americas and Europe.


About the Role

We are hiring an Executive Search Senior Associate to support Gold & Aron CEO and COO across high-impact searches in Technology and Financial Services in a premium boutique environment. The role blends deep research, pipeline development, and end-to-end recruiting for select mid-level roles. You’ll help build the engine that enables leadership to focus on client strategy and firm growth.


WHAT YOU WILL DO


Candidate Research & Sourcing for senior level searches (60%)

  • Build and manage strong candidate pipelines across multiple concurrent searches.
  • Active search: Conduct structured research, market mapping using several tech tools including Linkedin, AI tools and own data base.
  • Passive search: Source, screen applicants
  • Lead candidate scoring, initial candidate assessment


End to end Recruiting for selected mid level searches (30%)

  • Build and manage candidate pipeline
  • Conduct first-round screens to assess fit and motivation.
  • Prepare concise candidate summaries and search updates.
  • Support client communications and progress check-ins.
  • Coordinate interviews and every other step of the hiring process.


Business Development Support (10%)

  • Research companies, markets, and potential clients
  • Build prospect lists and market intelligence for the CEO and COO.
  • Bring new ideas, new BD initiatives for the company


IDEAL CANDIDATE PROFILE

  • 3–7+ years in research, consulting, finance, tech, recruiting, or similar fields.
  • Experience in or recruiting for Tech or Financial Services is a strong plus.
  • Advanced English + Native Portuguese is a must. Spanish is a strong plus.
  • Analytical, structured thinker with strong organization and attention to detail.
  • Comfortable with ambiguity; bias for action; strong ownership mindset.
  • Bachelor’s degree mandatory.
  • Location: Brazil remote. Preference for São Paulo, SP.

title: Consultor SAP MM/SRM
description:
Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Conduzir levantamento e análise de requisitos de negócio;
  • Traduzir necessidades complexas em soluções robustas em SAP;
  • Atuar em projetos de evolução do SAP SRM e integrações com S/4HANA, SAP BTP e sistemas externos;
  • Liderar testes funcionais, homologações e gestão de mudanças;
  • Apoiar na capacitação de equipe e fornecedores, garantindo consistência técnica;
  • Produzir relatórios executivos e apoiar stakeholders na tomada de decisão.


Requisitos Técnicos:

  • Superior completo ou Tecnólogo na área de formação;
  • Experiência em SAP (SRM/MM);
  • Domínio de processos de compras end-to-end no SRM;
  • Vivência em integrações complexas (APIs, Webservices, S/4HANA, SAP BTP);
  • Conhecimentos em SAP HANA, Fiori, UI5 e soluções em nuvem;
  • Experiência com testes unitários, integrados e homologações;
  • Inglês intermediário (comunicação e leitura técnica).
  • Experiência em metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban);
  • Vivência em projetos estratégicos de grande porte.
  • Especialização na área de atuação.


Contratação: PJ.

title: Junior/MidLevel React Developer - Remote
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the Role


The Junior/MidLevel React Developer will serve as a full-time problem solver, combining technical expertise, innovative thinking, and independence to tackle complex challenges across mobile and web platforms. This role demands a versatile developer ready to master the React technology stack and drive technological solutions.


Key Responsibilities:


- Designing practical solutions to solve complex technical challenges.

- Participating in code reviews and testing processes.

- Providing technological infrastructure for platform development.

- Working with big data and predictive analytics on distributed systems.

- Collaborating with development teams, product owners, and client services to innovate and complete tasks.


Requirements:


- React Experience: 2+ years in React development

- Front-End Skills: 2+ years of Front-End development with strong Javascript, CSS3, and HTML5 capabilities

- Framework Expertise: 1+ year developing Web applications using ReactJS, Flux, Redux, Relay

- Additional Frameworks: Experience with Angular, Backbone, Marionette

- JavaScript: Proficiency in ES2015 (ES6 / ES7)

- Technical Skills: Experience with command lines, APIs, and client-side performance

- Programming Fundamentals: Familiar with basic programming concepts, data structures, and variable types

- Language: Advanced English level



Benefits:

• Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

• Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

• Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

• Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

• Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

• Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

• Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

• Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: Head of Digital Media
description:
About VEL


Civilization is shifting.

AI is no longer confined to the browser. Work is decentralizing. Cities are restructuring. Corporate real estate is contracting.

VEL is building Physical AI infrastructure — intelligent, distributed environments embedded into airports, commercial buildings, and urban nodes.

VEGA is what people experience. IRIS is the intelligence layer that governs it.

We are not building consumer apps.

We are building embodied AI systems operating in real-world environments.

Perception matters. Narrative matters. Authority matters.

This role exists to shape how the world understands what we are building.

The Role

The Head of Digital Media & Social Strategy owns VEL’s external narrative architecture across digital platforms — with primary emphasis on executive-level social presence.

This is not a community manager role.

This is not a paid ads role.

This is not influencer marketing.

This is strategic storytelling at infrastructure scale.

You will shape how investors, real estate partners, technologists, and operators perceive VEL.

Core Responsibilities

● Architect and manage CEO digital presence (LinkedIn, X primarily)

● Translate complex Physical AI concepts into compelling, high-authority content

● Build structured content cadence aligned with fundraise and deployment milestones

● Draft executive-level thought leadership

● Develop long-form and short-form narrative

● Oversee visual language consistency across platforms

● Coordinate announcements (product, partnerships, capital)

● Track audience quality, not vanity metrics

● Align digital positioning with capital strategy

This role requires editorial precision, strategic thinking, and executive-level maturity.

Mandatory Qualifications (Non-Negotiable)

You must have:

● 5+ years leading digital strategy or executive communications

● Direct experience managing a C-level executive’s social presence

● Demonstrated experience writing long-form thought leadership

● Experience in venture-backed, deep-tech, B2B, or infrastructure environments

● Strong understanding of LinkedIn-native growth mechanics

● Fluent professional English (written and spoken)

● Comfort working closely with a founder

You Are Likely Coming From

● A venture-backed startup

● A B2B technology company

● A deep-tech or AI company

● A founder-brand building role

● An executive communications leadership position


You understand that:

● Authority compounds over time

● Digital presence influences capital perception

● Language shapes market category

● Precision matters more than volume

● Infrastructure companies must sound different than consumer brands

You are strategic.

You are literate.

You think long-term.

Who Should Not Apply

● Influencer marketers

● Lifestyle brand managers

● Pure paid performance marketers

● Meme-driven content creators

● Candidates without executive-level writing experience


Travel Requirement

Up to 45-60 days per year may be required for:

● Deployment launches

● Investor events

● Manufacturing visits

● Strategic announcements

Candidates must be comfortable with periodic international travel.

Compensation

$40,000 – $60,000 USD + performance-based equity

Compensation reflects executive narrative responsibility and long-term alignment.

Reporting Line

Reports directly to the CEO.

This role has strategic influence across fundraise, product positioning, and external communications.

Role Type

Full-time, long-term strategic hire.

We are building infrastructure for the next era of work.

Narrative discipline is part of that build.

title: Tech Lead Senior Service Now
description:
O que procuramos?

Atribuições principais:

Desenvolver técnicas outros colaboradores, transformando-as numa equipe que gera resultados;

Propor soluções com autonomia, apoiando a tomada de decisão de diferentes níveis de liderança;

Liderar o processo de consenso para decisões técnicas de alta complexidade nos tempos de desenvolvedores.

Articular a relação entre as demandas técnicas e de negócio para as equipes de desenvolvedores, considerando fatores internos e externos.

Aplicar treinamentos técnicos na equipe;

Efetuar alinhamento de processos com o cliente;

Apoiar a liderança na gestão de pessoas (feedbacks, entregas de resultados e planejamento da área).


Requisitos:

ServiceNow integrations Experience Service Management (ITSM, ITOM, SecOps), CMDB, Discovery Integration Hub, Flow Designer, Mid Servers, Scripted REST/SOAP, API Management.

INGLES FLUENTE


Localidade da posição: 100% REMOTO


Por que construir sua carreira na Meta?

Oferecemos autonomia, metas claras e um ambiente dinâmico e desafiador, onde os profissionais têm oportunidade de interagir com diferentes tecnologias, participar de todos os tipos de projetos, trazer novas ideias e trabalhar de qualquer lugar do Brasil e (por que não?) do mundo. Além disso, somos uma das melhores empresas para se trabalhar no Brasil segundo o Great Place to Work e uma das 10 empresas que mais crescem no país há 3 anos consecutivos, segundo o Anuário Informática Hoje.


Quais são nossos valores?

- Somos pessoas servindo pessoas

- Pensamos e agimos como donos

- Temos gana por performance

- Crescemos e aprendemos juntos

- Buscamos excelência e a simplicidade

- Temos inovação e criatividade no nosso DNA

Todas as pessoas são bem-vindas independentemente de sua condição, deficiência, etnia, crença religiosa, orientação sexual, aparência, idade ou afins. Queremos que você cresça conosco em um ambiente acolhedor e repleto de oportunidades.

Se identificou? Então, #VemSerMeta!

title: Senior Salesforce Developer
description:
We are a software startup dedicated to unifying ERP and CRM solutions into one seamless platform. As we prepare for growth, we are seeking an experienced Salesforce Developer that has hands-on experience, particularly with integrations and solution design and implementation.


Role Description

This is a full-time remote position for a Senior Salesforce Developer. The Senior Salesforce Developer will be responsible for designing, developing, and customizing Salesforce solutions, including creating and optimizing Visualforce Pages and Lightning Web Components. Responsibilities also include Salesforce.com administration, integration with other enterprise applications, troubleshooting, and maintaining scalable and secure solutions. Collaboration with cross-functional teams to meet business requirements is integral to this role. While remote, this role will be working during Eastern Standard Timezone (US) hours.


Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and customize Salesforce applications using Lightning and Apex
  • Collaborate with functional teams to gather and analyze business requirements
  • Build scalable, secure, and high-performance solutions
  • Perform debugging, testing, and deployment activities
  • Provide ongoing support and enhancements to existing applications


Qualifications

  • In-depth understanding of Salesforce.com platform capabilities and customization
  • Minimum 5 years of hands-on experience in Salesforce development
  • Strong expertise in Salesforce Lightning (LWC/Aura)
  • Experience with Agentic AI or AI-based solutions is a plus
  • Solid understanding of Apex, Triggers, Workflows, SOQL/SOSL, and integrations
  • Excellent troubleshooting and problem-solving skills
  • Strong communication skills with clients and stakeholders
  • Experience with Salesforce.com Administration tasks and configuration
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work with cross-functional teams
  • Salesforce Developer Certification or equivalent is preferred
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to work effectively in a remote, global environment


Company Perks & Benefits

  • Observance of major US Federal Holidays
  • 10 Paid Vacation Days + 5 Personal Days + 5 Sick Days in the 1st year of employment
  • Annual performance bonus
  • Client and employee referral bonus program

title: Full Stack Developer Pleno (Next.js + NestJS) — PJ Remoto
description:
Sobre a Evnts


A Evnts é uma empresa de tecnologia para o setor de eventos corporativos. Entre nossos clientes estão Itaú Unibanco, Grupo Boticário, AstraZeneca, Hospital Albert Einstein e centenas de outros incríveis para se trabalhar. Nosso propósito é criar o futuro de como eventos corporativos serão feitos e com as várias inovações dos últimos anos nos posicionamos na vanguarda dessa revolução, criando este futuro a quatro mãos com clientes e parceiros muito especiais.


O desafio


Como um(a) Evnter do time de Engenharia , você atuará no desenvolvimento de novas funcionalidades da plataforma e evolução das existentes, participando desde a modelagem das regras de negócio até a entrega final para o usuário.


Você trabalhará tanto no frontend quanto no backend utilizando Next.js e NestJS , sendo responsável por escrever código limpo, bem estruturado e testável. Esperamos alguém com preocupação real com arquitetura, organização do domínio e previsibilidade do sistema — não apenas implementação de tarefas.


﻿Você será medido pela qualidade das suas entregas, clareza técnica, responsabilidade sobre o que desenvolve e colaboração com o time para evoluir o produto de forma contínua.


Requisitos obrigatórios

  • Experiência com Node.js (NestJS ou similar);
  • Experiência com React / Next.js;
  • TypeScript;
  • APIs REST;
  • Banco de dados (preferencialmente MongoDB);
  • Testes automatizados;
  • Git e trabalho em equipe.


Diferenciais

  • Arquitetura (DDD / Clean Architecture);
  • Mensageria e sistemas distribuídos;
  • Cloud (AWS);
  • Performance e escalabilidade;
  • Uso de Inteligência Artificial no fluxo de desenvolvimento.


O que você encontra na Evnts

  • Papel com alta visibilidade e impacto real no negócio;
  • Autonomia para tomar decisões e conduzir projetos críticos;
  • Plano de crescimento claro, com possibilidade de evolução para posições de liderança;
  • Ambiente profissional, exigente e colaborativo.


Modelo de trabalho e contratação

  • Trabalho remoto;
  • Contratação PJ;
  • Sede da empresa em São Paulo (Vila Olímpia).

title: Demand Generation Manager
description:
About the role:

The Demand Generation Manager is responsible for ensuring that clients receive high-quality marketing execution that drives measurable results. Whether through points our hours, this role ensures work is delivered efficiently and transparently based on each client’s contract.

This role requires strong strategic thinking, project management, and client relationship skills to ensure marketing initiatives are effectively planned, executed, and optimized. You will act as the primary contact for clients, overseeing campaign execution, aligning resources, and ensuring projects are completed on time and within scope.

As an Account Manager , you’ll be responsible for translating client goals into actionable deliverables , managing project priorities, and ensuring each initiative aligns with their business objectives.


Key Responsibilities:Client Strategy & Execution

● Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned clients, ensuring clear communication and alignment on objectives.

● Guide quarterly strategy calls , translating business goals into structured marketing initiatives.

● Define and prioritize client deliverables , ensuring efficient execution.

● Proactively provide strategic insights and recommendations to enhance marketing performance.

Project & Resource Management

● Oversee the execution of marketing campaigns , coordinating with Specialists to achieve desired results.

● Monitor progress on deliverables , ensuring projects stay within the allocated scope.

● Manage deadlines, approvals, and revisions , ensuring seamless project completion.

● Work with internal teams to optimize workflows and improve efficiency in marketing execution.

Performance & Optimization

● Track and analyze marketing performance , identifying areas for optimization.

● Collaborate with channel heads and Account Directors to ensure high quality deliverables get produced and contribute to client goals.

● Regularly review client satisfaction and engagement , proactively addressing potential issues.

● Identify opportunities for upselling additional services that align with client needs.

● Collaborate with the Growth Manager to ensure high client retention and continued success.

Success Metrics

In this role, you’ll be accountable for the following key performance indicators:

● Client point burden , ensuring each client remains on track based on the amount of points/hours purchased.

● Client goals, ensuring we are hitting the pre-defined targets set forth to define specific outcomes from the engagement


Required Skills & Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of experience in-house in B2B digital marketing or demand generation, ideally within software and technology.
  • Hands-on experience managing paid media channels and optimizing digital performance.
  • Strong understanding of funnel metrics, digital attribution models, and revenue-oriented KPIs.
  • Excellent project management skills; capable of managing internal projects and multiple external vendors.
  • Strong analytical mindset with a solid grasp of attribution models and proficiency in tools like Google Analytics, DreamData, or similar.
  • Familiarity with technical tools like Google Tag Manager, and Optimizely or VWO.
  • The ability to self-direct and self-start and work independently as well as within and across teams.
  • Hands-on experience in using marketing automation technology (HubSpot) and CRM (HubSpot).
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth startup environment.
  • C1 or C2 English proficiency level.
  • CV and LinkedIn profile in English showcasing experience in chronological order.

Nice-to-Haves:

  • Prior experience in a growth-stage or scale-up SaaS business.
  • Familiarity with content personalization, dynamic content, or account-based web experiences.
  • Experience with SQL or business intelligence tools (e.g., Domo, Looker, Tableau, etc.).

You will act as the primary contact for clients, overseeing campaign execution, aligning resources, and ensuring projects are completed on time and within scope.

As an Account Manager , you’ll be responsible for translating client goals into actionable deliverables , managing project priorities, and ensuring each initiative aligns with their business objectives.


Key Responsibilities:Client Strategy & Execution

● Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned clients, ensuring clear communication and alignment on objectives.

● Guide quarterly strategy calls , translating business goals into structured marketing initiatives.

● Define and prioritize client deliverables , ensuring efficient execution.

● Proactively provide strategic insights and recommendations to enhance marketing performance.

Project & Resource Management

● Oversee the execution of marketing campaigns , coordinating with Specialists to achieve desired results.

● Monitor progress on deliverables , ensuring projects stay within the allocated scope.

● Manage deadlines, approvals, and revisions , ensuring seamless project completion.

● Work with internal teams to optimize workflows and improve efficiency in marketing execution.

Performance & Optimization

● Track and analyze marketing performance , identifying areas for optimization.

● Collaborate with channel heads and Account Directors to ensure high quality deliverables get produced and contribute to client goals.

● Regularly review client satisfaction and engagement , proactively addressing potential issues.

● Identify opportunities for upselling additional services that align with client needs.

● Collaborate with the Growth Manager to ensure high client retention and continued success.

Success Metrics

In this role, you’ll be accountable for the following key performance indicators:

● Client point burden , ensuring each client remains on track based on the amount of points/hours purchased.

● Client goals, ensuring we are hitting the pre-defined targets set forth to define specific outcomes from the engagement


Required Skills & Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of experience in-house in B2B digital marketing or demand generation, ideally within software and technology.
  • Hands-on experience managing paid media channels and optimizing digital performance.
  • Strong understanding of funnel metrics, digital attribution models, and revenue-oriented KPIs.
  • Excellent project management skills; capable of managing internal projects and multiple external vendors.
  • Strong analytical mindset with a solid grasp of attribution models and proficiency in tools like Google Analytics, DreamData, or similar.
  • Familiarity with technical tools like Google Tag Manager, and Optimizely or VWO.
  • The ability to self-direct and self-start and work independently as well as within and across teams.
  • Hands-on experience in using marketing automation technology (HubSpot) and CRM (HubSpot).
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth startup environment.
  • C1 or C2 English proficiency level.
  • CV and LinkedIn profile in English showcasing experience in chronological order.

Nice-to-Haves:

  • Prior experience in a growth-stage or scale-up SaaS business.
  • Familiarity with content personalization, dynamic content, or account-based web experiences.
  • Experience with SQL or business intelligence tools (e.g., Domo, Looker, Tableau, etc.).

title: ServiceNow Technical Architect
description:
ServiceNow Technical Architect


Start Date: ASAP

End Date: Aug 2026

100% remote

English and Portuguese are required

Candidates from LATAM


We are seeking a true Technical Architect (not a developer/consultant) to lead and drive developers in a CSM workstream. This role is the technical leader responsible for designing, building, and maintaining ServiceNow’s unified customer engagement platform (NOW Engage), serving Expert Services and Partner consultants globally.


The Technical Architect translates business requirements into scalable, maintainable solutions, ensures platform integrity and performance, and provides hands‑on technical leadership across the full delivery lifecycle.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design scalable ServiceNow solutions aligned with best practices.
  • Lead architecture for multi‑tenant NOW Engage, ensuring security, data isolation, and performance.
  • Architect integrations with external systems (REST APIs, Integration Hub, AI/GenAI features).
  • Guide scrum teams, oversee code reviews, and enforce technical standards.
  • Collaborate with Business Analysts, executives, and cross‑functional teams to align business and technical goals.
  • Ensure compliance with enterprise standards, security, and regulatory requirements (GDPR, CCPA).
  • Drive continuous improvement through monitoring, automation, CI/CD, and documentation.


Requirements:

  • 6–10+ years of ServiceNow experience (development, administration, architecture).
  • Deep knowledge of ServiceNow products (CSM, SPM, ITSM, ITOM).
  • Expertise in custom app development, advanced data models, workflows, and API integrations.
  • Strong coding skills (JavaScript, REST/SOAP APIs, Integration Hub, UI Builder).
  • Experience with multi‑tenant architecture, scalability, and performance optimization.
  • Ability to clearly communicate technical concepts to non‑technical stakeholders.


Preferred

  • ServiceNow CTA, CIS, or CAD certifications.
  • Experience with AI/GenAI integrations and Agile/SAFe methodologies.
  • Leadership of scrum teams and collaboration with external vendors.
  • Knowledge of cloud infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, and DevOps.


Key Attributes

  • Architectural thinking and problem‑solving.
  • Strong technical leadership and quality focus.
  • Executive presence with excellent communication skills.
  • Collaborative and adaptable in dynamic environments.
  • Willingness to travel up to 25% annually.

title: Product Designer
description:
SigmaMD aims to make a meaningful contribution to the world by changing the way people manage their health. Our growing engineering and product team has deep expertise in consumer tech. We are combining our diverse backgrounds to innovate in Digital Health.


Our goal is to make millions of lives healthier by using technology. We strive to empower patients to take control of their health care and help clinicians better treat them. To achieve this vision we need an outstanding and passionate Product Designer to take on the following responsibilities:


  • Contribute to high-level product thinking while also developing interaction flows, mockups, and prototypes. 
  • Collaborate in a cross-functional team to understand user needs and business goals, and translate them into intuitive and effective product designs.
  • Create wireframes, prototypes, and mockups to communicate design concepts and gather feedback.
  • Advocate for the needs and preferences of both doctors and patients by conducting user research and gathering feedback from both groups, and incorporating their insights into the design process to ensure the product meets the needs of all stakeholders.
  • Stay up-to-date with industry trends, design best practices, and the latest design tools and technologies to ensure the team is delivering high-quality, cutting-edge products.


This person should share our core values of teamwork, empathy, and innovation. Ideally, they have the following:


  • Know how to define a repeatable and shareable design process that encourages collaboration between design, product, and engineering teams.
  • Ask questions that build or help to clarify the problem statement and ensure that you maintain user focus and empathy.
  • Explore and refine concepts, then narrow to the best solution, weighing technical feasibility and scope with your team.
  • Create and maintain UX and UI deliverables including information architecture, wireframes, prototypes, style guides, micro interaction specifications, and pattern libraries.
  • Influence the product vision leading and participating in research, focused on both the intangibles (emotional needs) and tangibles (functional needs)..
  • Champion usability testing within your product team, capture the team's assumptions, identify the correct test methodology to use, document results, communicate actionable feedback and findings back to the team.
  • Communicate your design rationale to project stakeholders and use data to defend your design choices.


Required Skills

  • 2+ years of product design experience (including equivalent UI and UX focused role).
  • Able to provide samples of work that show creative solutions to complex products, strong visual design, and information architecture.
  • A strong understanding of the entire product development process, from research and problem solving through to detailed UI and visual design.
  • Experience with Figma.
  • Understand how modern technologies are used with design.
  • Believe that product and design decisions are inextricably linked.
  • Enjoy shipping small, quick experiments to explore and validate your ideas.
  • Know how to balance the user experience with technical and business requirements.
  • Able to communicate effectively with all stakeholders. Speak KPIs, OKRs and understand how to rely on data to support your work.
  • Not afraid to learn new things to take on a problem.
  • Are a self-starter who works proactively to solve problems and bring clarity to ambiguity
  • Facilitate both design-focused and cross-functional sessions with ease, relying on your knowledge of facilitation tools and techniques


Desired Skills

  • Have an understanding of front end technologies such as HTML and CSS.
  • Experience with Jira and Confluence.
  • Prior experience in a design related role at a startup.
  • Experience with digital health or relatable areas.
  • Experience working with mobile apps.

description:
SigmaMD aims to make a meaningful contribution to the world by changing the way people manage their health. Our growing engineering and product team has deep expertise in consumer tech. We are combining our diverse backgrounds to innovate in Digital Health.


Our goal is to make millions of lives healthier by using technology. We strive to empower patients to take control of their health care and help clinicians better treat them. To achieve this vision we need an outstanding and passionate Product Designer to take on the following responsibilities:


  • Contribute to high-level product thinking while also developing interaction flows, mockups, and prototypes. 
  • Collaborate in a cross-functional team to understand user needs and business goals, and translate them into intuitive and effective product designs.
  • Create wireframes, prototypes, and mockups to communicate design concepts and gather feedback.
  • Advocate for the needs and preferences of both doctors and patients by conducting user research and gathering feedback from both groups, and incorporating their insights into the design process to ensure the product meets the needs of all stakeholders.
  • Stay up-to-date with industry trends, design best practices, and the latest design tools and technologies to ensure the team is delivering high-quality, cutting-edge products.


This person should share our core values of teamwork, empathy, and innovation. Ideally, they have the following:


  • Know how to define a repeatable and shareable design process that encourages collaboration between design, product, and engineering teams.
  • Ask questions that build or help to clarify the problem statement and ensure that you maintain user focus and empathy.
  • Explore and refine concepts, then narrow to the best solution, weighing technical feasibility and scope with your team.
  • Create and maintain UX and UI deliverables including information architecture, wireframes, prototypes, style guides, micro interaction specifications, and pattern libraries.
  • Influence the product vision leading and participating in research, focused on both the intangibles (emotional needs) and tangibles (functional needs)..
  • Champion usability testing within your product team, capture the team's assumptions, identify the correct test methodology to use, document results, communicate actionable feedback and findings back to the team.
  • Communicate your design rationale to project stakeholders and use data to defend your design choices.


Required Skills

  • 2+ years of product design experience (including equivalent UI and UX focused role).
  • Able to provide samples of work that show creative solutions to complex products, strong visual design, and information architecture.
  • A strong understanding of the entire product development process, from research and problem solving through to detailed UI and visual design.
  • Experience with Figma.
  • Understand how modern technologies are used with design.
  • Believe that product and design decisions are inextricably linked.
  • Enjoy shipping small, quick experiments to explore and validate your ideas.
  • Know how to balance the user experience with technical and business requirements.
  • Able to communicate effectively with all stakeholders. Speak KPIs, OKRs and understand how to rely on data to support your work.
  • Not afraid to learn new things to take on a problem.
  • Are a self-starter who works proactively to solve problems and bring clarity to ambiguity
  • Facilitate both design-focused and cross-functional sessions with ease, relying on your knowledge of facilitation tools and techniques


Desired Skills

  • Have an understanding of front end technologies such as HTML and CSS.
  • Experience with Jira and Confluence.
  • Prior experience in a design related role at a startup.
  • Experience with digital health or relatable areas.
  • Experience working with mobile apps.

title: Business Development Manager (FX/CFD)
description:
D Prime is a globally recognized online broker, empowering professional investors with access to multi-asset CFD trading across global markets. With operational hubs in Dallas, London, Sydney, Singapore, Hong Kong, and Dubai, we combine advanced technology with deep industry expertise to deliver a seamless trading experience. We operate under multiple reputable financial licenses, including regulation by the UK Financial Conduct Authority (FCA), US SEC and FINRA, Australia’s ASIC, as well as authorities in Seychelles, Mauritius, and Vanuatu, ensuring strong compliance, transparency, and investor protection worldwide.


We are looking for a proactive and results-oriented Business Development Manager who will be responsible for expanding our client base, strengthening partnerships, and promoting our trading solutions across markets. This role requires strong knowledge of the online trading industry and the ability to convert opportunities into long-term business relationships.


Key Responsibilities


  • Develop new and existing markets and client base, promote our trading solutions
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with clients, IBs, and affiliates
  • Identify client trading needs and propose suitable brokerage services, platforms, and solutions
  • Effectively communicate the company’s value proposition, trading conditions, platforms, and partnership programs
  • Research sales statistics and assess growth opportunities within target markets
  • Maintain accurate records of leads, partners, and clients within the CRM system
  • Coordinate with internal departments (Dealing, Compliance, Marketing, Support) to ensure high service standards and client satisfaction
  • Conduct presentations, webinars, and platform demonstrations to prospective clients and partners


Key Requirements


  • Proven experience in Business Development / Sales within a CFD / Forex Brokerage
  • Strong understanding of FX, CFDs, trading platforms (e.g., MT4/MT5), and brokerage operations
  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills
  • Experience working with CRM systems and managing sales pipelines
  • Existing network of traders, IBs, or affiliates is a strong advantage
  • Ability to analyze market trends and identify revenue opportunities
  • Target-driven mindset with experience working toward KPIs and revenue goals
  • Willingness to travel for partner meetings, expos, and industry events


What We Offer


  • Competitive base salary & performance-based incentives and bonuses
  • Opportunity to influence regional partnership and client acquisition strategies
  • Career progression within a well-established Forex Brokerage environment
  • Exposure to global financial markets and advanced trading technologies
  • Flexible working arrangement


If you’re a results-driven business development professional with industry experience and a passion for building strong client and partner relationships, we’d love to hear from you. Apply today.

title: Coordenador de compatibilização de projetos
description:
Descrição do Cargo Estamos buscando um Coordenador de Compatibilização para integrar nossa equipe na Grande São Paulo. Este cargo envolve a gestão e integração de projetos arquitetônicos e de engenharia, garantindo sinergia entre diferentes disciplinas. As atividades principais incluem análise de projetos técnicos, identificação e resolução de conflitos, apresentação de propostas otimizadas e acompanhamento de prazo e qualidade das entregas. Este é um cargo de tempo integral, que requer dedicação presencial no local de trabalho.

Qualificações

  • Coordenação e Compatibilização de Projetos: Conhecimento comprovado na integração de diferentes disciplinas como arquitetura, engenharia elétrica e estrutural.
  • Habilidades Técnicas e Tecnológicas: Domínio em ferramentas de modelagem e softwares de compatibilização como AutoCAD, Revit e ferramentas BIM.
  • Comunicação e Resolução de Conflitos: Habilidade para articular-se com clientes, equipes multidisciplinares e fornecedores, identificando e solucionando potenciais conflitos de projeto.
  • Gerenciamento de Projetos: Experiência em gestão de prazos entregas, além de habilidades de organização e liderança de equipes.
  • Formação acadêmica em engenharia civil ou arquitetura será considerada um diferencial, juntamente com certificações em metodologias BIM e experiência anterior na área.

title: Especialista SAP [CPI / PI/PO]
description:
• Atuar na sustentação (AMS) das integrações entre SAP ECC6 (S/4HANA) e sistemas legados/terceiros, garantindo estabilidade e continuidade operacional.
  • Realizar triagem, análise e resolução de incidentes (falhas de processamento, inconsistências de dados, reprocessamentos).
  • Executar troubleshooting em SAP CPI (SCPI):
  • Atendimento de chamados via ferramenta de ITSM o Service Now
  • Monitoramento de iFlows
  • Análise de mensagens e logs
  • Retries e análise ponta a ponta
  • Apoiar correções e melhorias nas integrações:
  • Ajustes de mapeamento
  • Regras e tratamento de erros
  • Conduzir e apoiar testes integrados, validações e geração de evidências.
  • Manter documentação técnica e base de conhecimento, reduzindo recorrência de incidentes.
  • Colaborar com equipes de desenvolvimento, infraestrutura e negócio para alinhar soluções às necessidades estratégicas da empresa.
  • Identificar e solucionar problemas de integração, otimizando processos e garantindo alta disponibilidade.


Competências Técnicas


  • Experiência sólida com SAP Integration Suite CPI (iFlows, API Management, certificados, autenticação), e cenários Cloud e On-Premise,
  • Experiência sólida com SAP PI/PO (Integration Builder, Repository, Mappings, Adapters).
  • Conhecimentos em Web Services: XML, WSDL, SOAP, REST
  • Experiência com: Module Pool, ALV, User Exit / Enhancement-Point, BADIs, BAPIs, SAPScript, Smartforms, Adobe Forms, OData, CDS Views, SAP HANA.
  • Conhecimento SAP ABAP, e BTP.


CLT - REMOTO

title: Analista de Identidades Pleno - com Ansible
description:
Sobre a vaga

Nosso cliente busca um (a) Analista de Identidade Pleno ou Sênior para atuar em projetos de Gestão de Identidades e Acessos (IAM), com foco em implantação, integração, sustentação e evolução de soluções como Ping Identity (e similares). É imprescindível ter experiência com a ferramenta Ansible - ferramenta de solução de automação de TI usada para configurar, gerenciar e provisionar servidores, aplicações e infraestrutura de forma automática.

Descrição
  • Implantar e configurar soluções de IAM (ex.: Ping Identity, Okta, ForgeRock, Keycloak) seguindo arquiteturas e padrões definidos;
  • Participar de reuniões técnicas para entendimento de requisitos funcionais e não funcionais;
  • Criar e manter documentação técnica básica (configurações, fluxos, integrações e procedimentos operacionais);
  • Apoiar a squad na execução das atividades do dia a dia e na resolução de incidentes de média complexidade;
  • Participar de cerimônias ágeis (dailies, plannings, reviews e retrospectivas);
  • Realizar integrações entre sistemas legados e modernos utilizando protocolos de identidade e APIs;
  • Executar testes técnicos, homologações e validações de configurações;
  • Atuar em conformidade com padrões e boas práticas de segurança da informação.
Skills
  • Graduação em áreas correlatas.
  • Conhecimento sólido em protocolos de identidade e autenticação: OpenID Connect, OAuth 2.0 e SAML 2.0;
  • Vivência com sistemas operacionais Linux;
  • Conhecimento em Ansible para execução e manutenção de playbooks existentes, com ajustes pontuais sob orientação;
  • Conhecimento básico a intermediário em infraestrutura em nuvem (AWS, Azure, GCP ou OCI);
  • Experiência prática com LDAP e diretórios de identidade;
  • Noções de bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais;
  • Vivência em integrações via APIs REST;
  • Familiaridade com Git e pipelines simples de CI/CD;
  • Conhecimento básico de práticas de segurança e DevSecOps;
  • Capacidade de leitura e entendimento de código Java (não é necessário desenvolvimento avançado).
Diferenciais:
  • Experiência prévia com soluções IAM (Ping Identity, Okta, ForgeRock, Keycloak);
  • Conhecimento em automação de infraestrutura e scripts;
  • Noções de Zero Trust Architecture;
  • Conhecimento em processos de gerenciamento de credencial (criação, reset de senha, bloqueio/desbloqueio);
  • Certificações em IAM ou segurança da informação.
Competências Comportamentais:
  • Boa comunicação com times técnicos;
  • Organização e responsabilidade na execução das tarefas;
  • Capacidade de aprender rapidamente novas tecnologias;
  • Trabalho colaborativo em ambientes ágeis (Scrum/Kanban);
  • Postura proativa, com abertura para orientação técnica e feedback;
  • Interesse em evolução contínua na área de Identidade e Segurança.
Informações para o candidato
  • Vaga remota.
  • Salário compatível com o mercado.
  • Plano de saúde integral sem coparticipação e com quarto privativo.
  • Plano odontológico.
  • Bônus anual
  • Seguro de vida
  • Gympass/WellHub
  • Vale Refeição
  • Auxílio Creche.
  • Ajuda de custo de 50% mês para aula de inglês com professor via online
