title: Oracle Cloud HCM Engineer- Relocation to Portugal
description:
Your connection with Aubay starts in the following lines:

Aubay Portugal is a French multinational company that has been operating in the country since 2007, with offices in Lisbon and Porto. We are a leading technology consultancy with a presence in seven European Union countries, specializing in the management, implementation, development and maintenance of information systems.

With more than 150 active partners, we operate in strategic sectors such as banking, insurance, automotive, aviation, telecommunications, services and energy, driving innovation and digital transformation.

Excellence, proximity and innovation are the pillars that distinguish us and enable us to support companies in building technological solutions that make a difference.


What are we looking for?

  • 4-7 years of experience in application integration.
  • Minimum of 2 years of experience with Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC) or equivalent iPaaS .
  • At least 3 years of experience in SQL/ETL.
  • Proven experience with Oracle Cloud HCM , particularly Core HR processes and data model (assignments, salaries, organization structures).
  • Expertise in OIC, including orchestrations, REST/SOAP adapters, and XSLT.
  • Advanced proficiency in SQL.
  • Working knowledge of HDL/HSDL and BI Publisher (data model, bursting, security).
  • Ability to design, implement, and operate integrations around Oracle Cloud HCM, leveraging Oracle standards and tools (HCM Extracts, REST/SOAP APIs).
  • Experience in gathering requirements, securing data flows (GDPR compliance), documenting deliverables, and participating in architecture and data reviews.
  • Fluent in English (Expert level) and French are a plus.
  • Available to realocate to Portugal and work in hybrid setting in Lisbon.


What do we have to offer you?

  • Comprehensive health insurance, including dental coverage;
  • Feedback&Coffee – our integrated performance management system, with regular feedback sessions and a structured Career Progression Model;
  • Aubay Training Academy, designed for your development: technical and behavioural training (in-class and e-learning), Meet&Techs, Webinars, Mentoring and Technology Centers;
  • Events and team building activities that strengthen team spirit and promote closeness;
  • Digital platform for mental health and emotional well-being, with free psychology consultations, so you can take care of yourself at any time;
  • Health and well-being programme, with workshops and initiatives for our employees and other activities open to the community;
  • We grow with you and your family - we offer a Mini-Aubilous Kit when your children are born and annual support for school supplies, from pre-school to higher education;
  • Language platform, with conversation classes in 12 languages.


What makes us different?

  • Our organisational culture is based on solid values: commitment, excellence, team spirit, well-being, happiness and empathy;
  • We value and recognise those who are part of our history, with referral awards and a special birthday gift;
  • We believe in authenticity: we don't have a dress code, because what matters is talent and attitude;
  • We promote closeness and an informal environment;
  • Here, you will grow in good company, because we believe that professional development also means sharing experiences and building relationships.


Your next adventure starts here!

title: Engenheiro de dados Sênior
description:
A VMBears é uma empresa jovem e moderna com o objetivo de ajudar seus clientes a aproveitar novas tecnologias para acelerar seus negócios. Fornece serviços de consultoria para arquitetura corporativa e modernização de sistemas para nuvem. Fundada em 2018, possui em seu DNA a ética, a positividade, o comprometimento e a inovação. Somos focados em oferecer os melhores serviços prestados através dos melhores profissionais do mercado. Esses recursos são utilizados para auxiliar os clientes em sua jornada de modernização tecnológica e transformação digital.


O que buscamos?

O Engenheiro(a) de Dados é o profissional que constrói e mantém a infraestrutura responsável por mover, transformar e disponibilizar dados com confiabilidade e performance. Um(a) Engenheiro(a) de Dados eficaz domina pipelines batch + streaming, otimiza consultas em data-warehouses colunares e garante a rastreabilidade ponta-a-ponta de cada registro. Na prática, atua como elo entre arquitetura e desenvolvimento, permanecendo intrinsecamente ligado(a) ao código que sustenta o fluxo de informações.


Na VMBears, o Engenheiro(a) de Dados é o(a) guardião(ã) da qualidade dos dados: projeta pipelines escaláveis, monitora sua saúde em produção e antecipa gargalos. Para este projeto, a modernização de um motor de cálculo de alto volume no setor de energia, buscamos alguém que una profundidade técnica em processamento distribuído e lakehouse a uma mentalidade de produto baseada em dados.


Você integrará o squad que modernizará o Motor de Cálculo, um engine que processa bilhões de registros, aplica centenas de fórmulas regulatórias e gera resultados contábeis que movem o mercado de energia elétrica. Procuramos alguém que combine habilidade de modelar dados massivos com espírito de colaboração, ajudando o time a migrar de um monolito PL/SQL para uma plataforma distribuída, event-driven e cloud-native, onde cada byte chegue rápido, íntegro e auditável ao novo motor.


Responsabilidades:

  • Implementar soluções com arquitetura de dados distribuída, garantindo latência e throughput que atendam aos requisitos da do negócio;

Atendentes Comercial Bilíngue (Inglês Nativo Americano)

title: ESPECIALISTA EM ESTATÍSTICA E DADOS
description:
Company Description

A XMX Corp é uma empresa de performance digital focada em escalar funis de vendas com base em dados e resultados reais. Atuamos com marketing direto, otimização de conversão e inteligência operacional para maximizar lucro e eficiência. Nosso principal foco é atrair e desenvolver afiliados de alta performance, fortalecendo nosso modelo B2B e ampliando escala. Valorizamos velocidade, adaptação e execução prática para crescer de forma consistente e sustentável.


RESPONSABILIDADES:
  • Estruturar modelos estatísticos para apoiar decisões estratégicas da empresa;
  • Aplicar métodos estatísticos avançados para análise de performance (funil, ofertas, backend, retenção, reembolso, churn);
  • Desenvolver modelos preditivos para:
  • Projeção de receita
  • Probabilidade de recompra
  • Tendência de reembolso
  • Lifetime Value (LTV)
  • Elasticidade de preço
  • Analisar experimentos e testes A/B com rigor estatístico
  • Criar modelos de atribuição e correlação entre variáveis de negócio;
  • Elevar o nível de confiabilidade dos dados e análises da empresa;
  • Identificar vieses, inconsistências e distorções nos dados;
  • Construir dashboards estratégicos com foco em tomada de decisão;
  • Apoiar diretoria na interpretação estatística de cenários e projeções;
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com Funil, Backend, Financeiro e Oferta para traduzir dados em estratégias práticas.
  • Organização de todos os testes que estão sendo feitos na empresa, documentação e análise.
QUALIFICAÇÕES:
  • Formação sólida em Estatística, Matemática, Engenharia, Física ou áreas correlatas;
  • Domínio avançado de estatística descritiva e inferencial;
  • Conhecimento profundo em:
  • Probabilidade
  • Regressão
  • Testes de hipótese
  • Modelagem preditiva
  • Séries temporais
  • Análise multivariada
  • Experiência com análise de experimentos (A/B testing);
  • Experiência com grandes bases de dados;
  • Capacidade de traduzir análises complexas em decisões claras para o negócio.
  • Diferencial :
  • Conhecimento em Python (Pandas, NumPy, SciPy, Statsmodels ou similares); 
  • Conhecimento em SQL;
  • Vivência em ambientes de alta velocidade (startup ou digital).
  • Experiência com marketing digital ou e-commerce;
COMPETÊNCIAS:
  • RIGOR ANALÍTICO
  • PENSAMENTO LÓGICO
  • FOCO EM RESULTADO
  • PRECISÃO
  • CAPACIDADE DE SIMPLIFICAR O COMPLEXO
  • PROATIVIDADE
SALÁRIO:
  • A combinar
  • Bônus trimestral - Vale a partir do segundo trimestre dentro da empresa.
TIPO DE CONTRATAÇÃO:
  • A prestação de serviço será feita no Regime PJ.
  • 100% Home Office
COMO FUNCIONA O TRABALHO:
  • Nossa comunicação é feita pelo discord, o candidato aprovado tem que estar disponível na plataforma para responder e se comunicar. (Você receberá treinamento para isso)
  • Usamos o ClickUp para gerenciar as atividades da equipe. (Você receberá treinamento para isso)
  • O candidato selecionado terá um período de três meses para ganhar experiência na empresa antes de ser efetivado na vaga

title: Senior Media Buyer | Stealth Manager
description:
Senior Media Buyer (Lead Generation & Patient Acquisition) | 100% remote


About the Role

We are hiring a senior-level performance marketer to own strategy, execution, and optimization of multi-account paid media campaigns focused on lead generation and appointment booking for local healthcare providers. This is a hands-on, high-accountability role managing complex campaign portfolios across Meta Ads and Google Ads.

This position is best suited for operators who are deeply analytical, comfortable managing scale, and experienced in service-based lead generation (not ecommerce).


What You Will Own

  • Full-funnel paid media strategy for local lead generation campaigns
  • Campaign build, optimization, and scaling across multiple client accounts
  • Budget allocation, audience strategy, creative testing, and performance improvement
  • Lead quality analysis and conversion performance optimization
  • Performance reporting, insights, and strategic recommendations
  • Continuous testing of messaging, offers, and conversion drivers


Must-Have Experience

  • 5+ years managing Meta Ads AND Google Ads professionally
  • Proven experience generating leads for local or service-based businesses
  • Demonstrated success managing multiple accounts simultaneously
  • Hands-on optimization experience focused on CPL and conversion quality
  • Experience with appointment-based funnels (consultations, bookings, or patient acquisition)
  • Strong analytical decision-making based on performance data


Strongly Preferred

  • Healthcare or chiropractic marketing experience
  • Experience managing 15+ accounts concurrently
  • Advanced understanding of local advertising and geographic targeting
  • Experience working in agency environments
  • Clear, professional spoken English for client-adjacent collaboration

This is a hands-on, high-accountability role managing complex campaign portfolios across Meta Ads and Google Ads.

This position is best suited for operators who are deeply analytical, comfortable managing scale, and experienced in service-based lead generation (not ecommerce).


What You Will Own

  • Full-funnel paid media strategy for local lead generation campaigns
  • Campaign build, optimization, and scaling across multiple client accounts
  • Budget allocation, audience strategy, creative testing, and performance improvement
  • Lead quality analysis and conversion performance optimization
  • Performance reporting, insights, and strategic recommendations
  • Continuous testing of messaging, offers, and conversion drivers


Must-Have Experience

  • 5+ years managing Meta Ads AND Google Ads professionally
  • Proven experience generating leads for local or service-based businesses
  • Demonstrated success managing multiple accounts simultaneously
  • Hands-on optimization experience focused on CPL and conversion quality
  • Experience with appointment-based funnels (consultations, bookings, or patient acquisition)
  • Strong analytical decision-making based on performance data


Strongly Preferred

  • Healthcare or chiropractic marketing experience
  • Experience managing 15+ accounts concurrently
  • Advanced understanding of local advertising and geographic targeting
  • Experience working in agency environments
  • Clear, professional spoken English for client-adjacent collaboration

title: Analista de Administração Pessoal e Benefícios Junior
description:
Responsável por assegurar a correta administração dos processos de ponto, benefícios e apoio aos cálculos de folha de pagamento, garantindo conformidade legal, acuracidade das informações e cumprimento de prazos. Atuará no controle e conferência de dados trabalhistas, apoiando a consistência dos lançamentos, mitigação de riscos e melhoria contínua dos processos de administração de pessoal.


Principais responsabilidades

  • Realizar a gestão e conferência do controle de ponto eletrônico, tratando inconsistências, banco de horas, horas extras, afastamentos e escalas.
  • Garantir cumprimento de prazos legais e obrigações acessórias relacionadas à compra, cadastro e disponibilização dos benefícios.
  • Atuar na interface com fornecedores de folha e benefícios, assegurando qualidade e precisão das informações.
  • Apoiar o processamento da folha de pagamento, realizando conferências prévias, validação de eventos e suporte aos cálculos trabalhistas.
  • Administrar benefícios (vale-transporte, vale-refeição/alimentação, plano de saúde, seguro, entre outros), incluindo movimentações, inclusões, exclusões e conferências de faturas.
  • Elaborar relatórios gerenciais e controles internos relacionados aos benefícios.
  • Apoiar o controle e cálculo de férias, 13º salário, admissões, desligamentos e encargos sociais.


Formação e Conhecimentos

  • Nível superior completo em Administração, Ciências Contábeis, Gestão de RH ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência prévia em administração de pessoal e rotinas de folha de pagamento.
  • Vivência com controle de ponto eletrônico e gestão de benefícios.
  • Conhecimento de legislação trabalhista e encargos sociais.
  • Excel intermediário/avançado.
  • Desejável experiência com sistemas de folha e e-Social.

title: Digital Marketing Specialist
description:
PLEASE READ THE JOB DESCRIPTION BEFORE APPLYING


Metrobi is a VC-backed startup and an alumni of Techstars Boston, one of the leading accelerators in the USA.


We power deliveries for local food and beverage businesses in Boston, New York, DC, Chicago, LA, and other major metropolitan areas. Our technology is at the center of our delivery marketplace.


Intro video:


Why should you join Metrobi?

  • Play a key role in shaping performance marketing strategy.
  • Fast-paced, growth-oriented environment with plenty of room to test & learn.
  • Opportunity to directly impact conversions and revenue.
  • International team experience and a supportive work environment.
  • A well-funded company that offers competitive compensation.
  • An opportunity to learn every day in a fast-paced environment.
  • A chance to become a part of a dynamic company on a fast track to change the logistics scene in the US.


About the role

We’re looking for a data-driven Digital Marketing Specialist who loves experimenting, optimizing, and scaling growth. If you enjoy working with WordPress and creating compelling content for emails and landing pages, this role is for you.


  • Professional English Proficiency is a must.
  • Hiring interviews will be conducted online.


What you’ll do:

  • Build and iterate on landing pages (WordPress + Elementor), testing buttons, hero texts, CTAs, and layouts.
  • Run A/B tests & experiments to improve conversion rates continuously.
  • Track, analyze, and report performance.
  • Understand the audience and work on improving the copy from email marketing campaigns.


(Musts)

We’re looking for someone that has hands-on experience with:

  • WordPress & Elementor.
  • SEO
  • Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO) and A/B testing.
  • Creating content for email marketing campaigns
  • Landing page creation


This role is not for you if:

  • You have only worked with Ads and paid media before.
  • You have only worked for marketing agencies before
  • You don't have any experience with generating leads and measuring the results .


Nice to have:

  • Basic HTML/CSS
  • Understanding of UI/UX principles for better user journeys.
  • Experience with Google Ads / Meta Ads / LinkedIn Ads
  • Familiarity with Google Sheets


  • This is a remote position.
  • Must be able to work between (9AM-6PM EST)

title: Azure Cloud Architect - 100% Remote
description:
Azure Cloud Architect - 100% Remote

Candidate Location – Brazil

12 Months plus contract

Start date - immediately

Rate - DOE


15+ years of IT experience and minimum of 10+ years using public cloud offerings such as Microsoft Azure, Azure Migrate, Azure SQL IaaS/PaaS, Azure Storage , Azure Key Vault, Azure IAM


Primary skills:

  • Demonstrates a high level of proficiency and hands-on expertise in delivering high quality designs using Architecture frameworks
  • Conducting AS-IS assessments of applications, designing target state architecture, and obtaining approvals from client architecture review board.
  • Expertise in On-prem/Public cloud Infra assessments using Azure Migrate
  • Driving the cloud Solutioning Azure activities for large complex migration
  • Ensure that the proposed solution covers Azure strategy, stakeholder management as well as the actual solution covering Business, Application and Infrastructure as well as commercial aspects (in terms of value for money and not commercial costing etc.)
  • Working experience with various industry domains like banking, healthcare, Insurance
  • Understanding customer Infra landscape. Design and build Azure Landing Zone activities
  • Provide the Azure target architecture and its BoM pricing and licensing related details
  • Azure Target Solutions architect Diagram (all Azure services) including HLD & LLD
  • Troubleshooting experience with Azure & Windows environments (Processor, networking, clusters, IO, memory etc. related issues)

title: Accounting Manager - US GAAP
description:
Lead US Accounting. Operate at a Global Standard.

  • MAVI is building a high-performance global finance network — embedding senior accounting leaders across LATAM directly into US leadership teams.
  • We are hiring experienced US Accounting Managers who are ready to operate as trusted finance partners to US CFOs and Controllers — owning close cycles, financial reporting, and operational excellence.


The Opportunity

You will serve as a direct extension of a US finance team, leading month-end close and overseeing reporting accuracy for high-growth and mid-market US companies.

This role is designed for senior professionals who want:

  • Direct collaboration with US leadership
  • High ownership and accountability
  • Exposure to global accounting standards
  • Long-term strategic partnership


What You Will Own

  • Lead and manage full month-end close under US GAAP
  • Oversee journal entries, reconciliations, and reporting packages
  • Ensure financial statements are accurate and timely
  • Supervise and guide accounting team members
  • Interface directly with US Controllers and CFOs
  • Strengthen reporting frameworks and internal controls
  • Drive process improvements and operational efficiency


What We’re Looking For

  • 6–8+ years of US GAAP accounting experience
  • Demonstrated leadership of close cycles
  • Experience managing or mentoring accounting teams
  • Strong financial reporting and GL expertise
  • Experience working directly with US stakeholders
  • ERP exposure (NetSuite preferred)
  • Strong professional English communication


Why Join MAVI

  • Operate at the same standard as US-based finance teams
  • Gain direct visibility with US leadership
  • Work on sophisticated, scaling businesses
  • Be part of a curated global network of senior accounting professionals


This Role Is Ideal For

  • Senior accounting leaders in LATAM who want more than transactional accounting — and are ready to operate as strategic finance partners within US organizations.

  • Ensure financial statements are accurate and timely
  • Supervise and guide accounting team members
  • Interface directly with US Controllers and CFOs
  • Strengthen reporting frameworks and internal controls
  • Drive process improvements and operational efficiency

  • 6–8+ years of US GAAP accounting experience
  • Demonstrated leadership of close cycles
  • Experience managing or mentoring accounting teams
  • Strong financial reporting and GL expertise
  • Experience working directly with US stakeholders
  • ERP exposure (NetSuite preferred)
  • Strong professional English communication


Why Join MAVI

  • Operate at the same standard as US-based finance teams
  • Gain direct visibility with US leadership
  • Work on sophisticated, scaling businesses
  • Be part of a curated global network of senior accounting professionals


This Role Is Ideal For

  • Senior accounting leaders in LATAM who want more than transactional accounting — and are ready to operate as strategic finance partners within US organizations.

title: Executive Assistant (Technical)
description:
Executive Assistant (Technical)

Salary: $1250 - $1500 / month

Working Hours: Central Time

Employment Type: Full-Time

Location : Remote


About the Role

We’re hiring an Executive Assistant to support the founder across both traditional EA responsibilities and technical project coordination.


You’ll help keep day-to-day operations organized, while also translating ideas and conversations into clear work streams that developers can execute against.


We’re looking for someone product-minded — someone who thinks about how things should work, asks good questions, and cares about quality. If you’re highly organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable working with software tools and technical teams, this role is a strong fit.


Key Responsibilities

  • Support the founder with traditional executive assistant tasks (scheduling, organization, follow-ups, documentation, coordination)
  • Watch client calls or internal discussions and turn them into clear work streams and task lists
  • Explain to developers exactly what needs to be built and why
  • Test features and applications after development and document issues or improvements
  • Perform light setup and cleanup in tools like Airtable, Notion, and Excel / Google Sheets


Required Skills & Qualifications

  • +2 years of experience as an Executive Assistant
  • Excellent written and spoken English
  • Strong organization and attention to detail
  • Comfortable using tools like Excel / Google Sheets, Airtable, Notion, and task management tools
  • Able to communicate clearly with both non-technical and technical teammates


Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience supporting US-based founders or agencies
  • Prior exposure to QA / testing or software-related projects


Why Join Us?

  • Work directly with the founder
  • Get hands-on experience coordinating real software and automation projects
  • Build transferable skills in technical project coordination and operations

title: Profissional Desenvolvedor .NET Pleno/Sênior
description:
Código da vaga: 51671


Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

Nossos 2.500 mil funcionários atuam no modelo de trabalho Anywhere Office e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


Ei #fera , chegou o momento de encarar um novo desafio em sua carreira! Venha ser um #ferabrq !


No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia! É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.


Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.


O que procuramos?


Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!



O que você deve ter?


- Mais de 4 anos de experiência em .NET nas versões atuais;

- Experiência em AWS ( Ec2, S3, SNS, SQS, Lambdas);

- Experiência com microsserviços, padrões de projetos modernos, boas práticas de arquitetura dominando conceitos;

- Experiência com Programação orientada a objetos (POO);

- Atuar profissionalmente com filas de mensageria;

- Familiaridade com sistemas com muitas requisições e alta escalabilidade.


O que temos pra te oferecer?


A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:


Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!


Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.


Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.


Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


As oportunidades são CLT com muitos benefícios, olha só:


Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Home Office; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


Como é trabalhar na BRQ?


Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions .


Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

title: Remote AI Quality Analyst (Portuguese) - 62131
description:
About Turing:


Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L.


Role Overview:


As an AI Quality Analyst, you will evaluate a new personalization feature for Gemini. You will assess how well the model uses information from your past Gemini conversations, Gmail, Google Search, and YouTube activity to make responses more relevant and helpful. This role requires a unique blend of creativity and analytical rigor. You will actively design prompts from the perspective of your own personal experiences. You will then use your analytical skills to assess the quality of the model's personalized responses, evaluating dimensions like Grounding, Integration, and Helpfulness.


Key Qualifications:

  • Portuguese Proficiency: Ability to read and write in Portuguese with a high degree of comp, as Portuguese is the focus language for this project.
  • Personal Account Usage: Willingness to use your primary personal Google account (not a testing account) and enable personal data sources for a genuine assessment.
  • Schedule Flexibility: Full-time availability in your local time zone is required. We are staffing a global, 24-hour operations team.
  • Exceptional Analytical Thinking: Demonstrate ability to evaluate nuanced and ambiguous AI responses, specifically assessing personalization quality.
  • Creative Prompt Engineering: Experience in designing creative, multi-turn starting prompts based on personal context to thoroughly test the model's capabilities.
  • Strong Evaluation Acumen: Understanding of personalization concepts, including the ability to identify incorrect personalization, poor inferences, and forced connections.
  • Meticulous Attention to Detail: The ability to review Side-by-Side (SxS) model responses and spot subtle differences in naturalness and overnarrating.
  • Excellent Written Communication: Superior ability to write clear, concise, and structured rationales for model rankings, explicitly referencing specific turn numbers.
  • Feedback: Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Communication: Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence: Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Technical Setup: Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Description:

  • In this role, you will be part of a dynamic team focused on evaluating the quality of personalized AI interactions.

Your day-to-day work will involve:

  • Designing and executing multi-turn conversational prompts (typically 1-5 turns) that require the AI to utilize your personal information and experiences.
  • Evaluating model responses based on your intent from the starting prompt, checking if the personalization was appropriately applied.
  • Analyzing responses for Grounding issues, ensuring claims about you are supported by evidence and not flawed inferences or hallucinations.
  • Assessing Integration quality to ensure personal data is woven naturally into the response without robotic \"overnarrating\".
  • Rigorously evaluating and stack-ranking two model responses side-by-side (SxS) to determine which is overall more helpful, easy to use, and enjoyable.
  • Writing clear, defensible rationales for your comparisons, explicitly referencing where issues or positive aspects occurred in the conversation.
  • Extracting and verifying \"Debug Info\" from the model to confirm that chat summaries and data sources were properly utilized.
  • Maintaining strict data hygiene by deleting evaluation conversations to prevent them from polluting your future chat history.


Education & Experience:

  • BS/BA degree or equivalent experience in a relevant field (e.g., Policy, Law, Ethics, Linguistics, Journalism, Computer Science, or a related analytical field).
  • Experience in data annotation, AI quality evaluation, content moderation, or a related role is strongly preferred.


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required: at least 4 hours per day and minimum 30 hours per week with 4 hours of overlap with PST. (We have 2 options of time commitment: 30 hrs/week or 40 hrs/week)
  • Engagement type: Contractor
  • Engagement Length: 3 months



After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.

title: Brazil Packaging Salesperson, Remote
description:
We are a leading cosmetic packaging company. Our product offerings support beauty, personal care, and cosmetic brands with high-quality, compliant, and market-ready packaging.


Role Description


We are seeking an experienced Brazilian Cosmetic Packaging Salesperson to join our sales team. This is a full-time remote position reporting to our Sales Manager. The ideal candidate will have proven experience selling cosmetic and personal care packaging products into Brazilian markets, with a strong understanding of Brazilian business practices, regulations, and cultural nuances.


Compensation: $65,000 to $135,000 per year, depending on experience.


Responsibilities


The successful candidate will be responsible for:


- Developing and maintaining relationships with Brazilian cosmetic and personal care brands

- Identifying and pursuing new sales opportunities within Brazil's cosmetic packaging market

- Presenting cosmetic packaging solutions tailored to brand, regulatory, and consumer requirements

- Managing sales pipelines, forecasting, and reporting

- Collaborating with product development, compliance, and logistics teams to ensure customer satisfaction

- Meeting and exceeding sales targets

- Staying informed on market trends, regulations, and competitor activity in Brazilian cosmetic packaging markets


Qualifications


- Proven track record of successful B2B sales in cosmetic packaging or closely related packaging industries

- Extensive experience working with Brazilian cosmetic, beauty, or personal care markets and customers

- Strong knowledge of Brazilian cosmetic packaging regulations, standards, and labeling requirements

- Fluent in English and Portuguese

- Excellent communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills

- Ability to travel to Brazil as needed (20-30% of the time)

- Bachelor's degree in Business, Sales, or a related field

- Proficiency with CRM systems and sales tools

- Salesforce experience is a plus

title: SAP Cloud Architect - SAP Basis
description:
About HCLTech


HCLTech is a global technology company, spread across 60 countries, delivering industry-leading capabilities centered around digital, engineering, cloud and AI, powered by a broad portfolio of technology services and products. We work with clients across all major verticals, providing industry solutions for Financial Services, Manufacturing, Life Sciences and Healthcare, Technology and Services, Telecom and Media, Retail and CPG, and Public Services. We re powered by our people a global, diverse, multi-generational talent - representing 161 nationalities whose unique spark, perspective and boundless passion drive our culture of proactive value creation and problem-solving.


To learn more about how we can supercharge progress for you, visit


Are you an experienced SAP Basis Consultant ready to take the next step in your career? Join our Cloud Architect Advisory (CAA) team as a SAP Cloud Architect, where you'll guide customers through their SAP RISE journey and shape the future of enterprise landscapes.


About the Role


As a SAP Cloud Architect, you’ll be the strategic advisor for customers transitioning to the SAP RISE platform. This customer-facing role involves planning, designing, and presenting SAP landscape architectures tailored to each client’s needs and hyperscaler preferences (AWS, Azure, GCP). You’ll collaborate closely with SAP Sales and Account Executives to ensure technical accuracy and optimal design.


Note: This is a purely architectural role—no hands-on implementation required.


What You’ll Gain


Exposure to cutting-edge SAP technologies: S/4HANA, HANA DB, MDG, Ariba, Salesforce, and more.

Access to SAP’s internal training and learning resources.

Experience across multiple industries and customer landscapes.

A unique opportunity to work on diverse architecture setups not typically available in standard SAP Basis roles.

About HCLTech


HCLTech is a global technology company, spread across 60 countries, delivering industry-leading capabilities centered around digital, engineering, cloud and AI, powered by a broad portfolio of technology services and products. We work with clients across all major verticals, providing industry solutions for Financial Services, Manufacturing, Life Sciences and Healthcare, Technology and Services, Telecom and Media, Retail and CPG, and Public Services. We re powered by our people a global, diverse, multi-generational talent - representing 161 nationalities whose unique spark, perspective and boundless passion drive our culture of proactive value creation and problem-solving.


To learn more about how we can supercharge progress for you, visit


Are you an experienced SAP Basis Consultant ready to take the next step in your career? Join our Cloud Architect Advisory (CAA) team as a SAP Cloud Architect, where you'll guide customers through their SAP RISE journey and shape the future of enterprise landscapes.


About the Role


As a SAP Cloud Architect, you’ll be the strategic advisor for customers transitioning to the SAP RISE platform. This customer-facing role involves planning, designing, and presenting SAP landscape architectures tailored to each client’s needs and hyperscaler preferences (AWS, Azure, GCP). You’ll collaborate closely with SAP Sales and Account Executives to ensure technical accuracy and optimal design.


Note: This is a purely architectural role—no hands-on implementation required.


What You’ll Gain


Exposure to cutting-edge SAP technologies: S/4HANA, HANA DB, MDG, Ariba, Salesforce, and more.

Access to SAP’s internal training and learning resources.

Experience across multiple industries and customer landscapes.

A unique opportunity to work on diverse architecture setups not typically available in standard SAP Basis roles.

title: Finance Operations Manager
description:
Job Title: Finance & Operations Manager (Part-Time)

About the Company:

Our client is a fast-growing B2B software company providing enterprises, especially financial institutions, with a platform to accelerate innovation. The platform simplifies the discovery, validation, and scaling of vendors, tools, and data solutions, reducing the time, risk, and cost associated with adopting fintech solutions.

Job Description:

Our client is seeking a Finance & Operations Manager to work closely with the CFO and take ownership of day-to-day finance and selected operational responsibilities. This is a hands-on, number-two role within the finance function, ideal for someone who enjoys both detailed execution and contributing to strategic initiatives in a scaling environment. This position is part-time and fully remote.

Responsibilities:

• Lead and own the month-end close and bookkeeping processes.

• Consolidate multiple entities into a single, accurate set of accounts (essential requirement).

• Manage day-to-day accounts payable and receivable processes.

• Support the CFO with financial planning, KPI tracking, and preparation of investor materials.

• Maintain and update financial forecasts and cash flow models.

• Support international expansion initiatives from a finance and compliance perspective.

• Assist with operational responsibilities, including contributing to SOC 2 and ISO certification processes.

• Identify process improvements across Finance and Operations and implement practical solutions.

Required Experience and Qualifications:

• Qualified accountant (ACA, ACCA, CIMA or equivalent).

• Proven experience consolidating multiple entities into one set of accounts.

• Strong experience leading month-end close processes and managing bookkeeping.

• Experience in fast-paced or high-growth environments.

• Strong attention to detail with a high level of reliability and diligence.

• Ability to work autonomously and balance multiple priorities effectively.

Preferred Skills:

• Experience maintaining and updating financial forecasts and cash flow models.

• Experience with cap table management software and compliance processes.

• Exposure to supporting audit, certification, or regulatory processes (e.g., SOC 2, ISO).

Personality:

• Hands-on and proactive, with a willingness to take ownership.

• Comfortable operating both at a detailed level and in strategic discussions.

• Flexible working style with strong organizational skills.

• Collaborative and adaptable in a scaling business environment.

Software & Tools:

• Accounting and bookkeeping software.

• Financial forecasting and cash flow modeling tools.

• Cap table management software.

• Compliance and certification tracking tools (SOC 2, ISO).

English Level:

C2

Schedule:

Part-Time UK Business Hours

Salary and Benefits:

• Payment in USD or Local Currency according to candidate's preference.

• Opportunity to play a pivotal role in shaping the finance function within a high-growth company.

• Supportive and collaborative working environment.

title: Desenvolvedor full stack
description:
Mandatory Requirements:


  • Extensive experience collaborating with US companies.
  • Minimum 8+ years in software engineering .
  • Strong expertise in TypeScript backend development.
  • Deep understanding of API design using REST/GraphQL , distributed systems , and database architecture involving both SQL and NoSQL .
  • Experienced with cloud environments such as AWS , GCP , or Azure .
  • Familiarity with CI/CD and DevOps best practices .
  • Solid experience building frontend applications with React .
  • Advanced English skills are a must for technical discussions.
  • Strong experience in system design and architectural ownership.


Desirable Requirements:


  • Familiarity with Docker and Kubernetes .
  • Experience with microservices architecture .
  • Knowledge of Agile methodologies such as Scrum .
  • Experience with serverless technologies .
  • Proficiency with monitoring tools like Prometheus or Grafana .


Summary of Requirements: US companies, 8+ years of experience, software engineering, TypeScript backend development, API design, REST / GraphQL, distributed systems, database architecture, SQL, NoSQL, cloud environments, AWS, GCP, Azure, CI/CD, DevOps best practices, React, system design.

title: Staff Frontend Software Engineer | BASE Team
description:
At Wellhub (Permanent), in Brazil
Expires at:
Remote policy: Full remote GET TO KNOW US

At Wellhub we're revolutionizing workplace wellness. Our platform connects employees worldwide to the best partners for fitness, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition, and sleep—all in one simple subscription. Headquartered in NYC with team members in 11 countries, we’re on a mission to make every company a wellness company.
We believe work should be fulfilling, inspiring, and balanced. Here, you’ll find a team that values wellbeing, collaboration, and different perspectives, where passion and creativity push boundaries to create real impact. Your contributions will help shape a healthier, more balanced world for you and millions of people globally.
Join us in redefining the future of wellbeing! 
THE OPPORTUNITY

We are hiring a Staff Frontend Software Engineer (Individual Contributor) to join our BASE FA Teams in Brazil ! This is a Remote – Brazil position, meaning you can work from anywhere within the country. Please note that this role is only open to candidates in Brazil.
At the BASE (Business Architecture Services), we build the heart of the Wellhub business model. Our mission is to help Wellhub build a truly scalable platform to support dozens of millions of active users and clients around the world with high availability while being flexible and extensible to incorporate new business models.
In this role, you will go beyond coding — you will drive technical excellence across services and teams, mentoring engineers, shaping frontend architecture, and ensuring Wellhub continues to deliver reliable, scalable, and user-centric solutions. As a Staff/Specialist Frontend Engineer, you will take end-to-end ownership of some critical product flows and deliveries. You will be involved from the beginning of the product lifecycle, partnering with product and design, defining technical approaches, and delivering high-impact solutions. Your work will ensure performance, reliability, and overall product excellence across BASE services.
This role combines strong frontend expertise with leadership in a critical position that delivers meaningful impact across the organization, spanning from system architecture to implementation.
YOUR IMPACT

  • Lead the frontend development in the BASE Focus Area, influencing architecture and design decisions across teams.
  • Design and implement straightforward solutions to complex scenarios, ensuring scalability and maintainability.
  • Work closely with product managers and designers to translate vision and needs into technical solutions that make sense to the engineering team, and vice versa.
  • Serve as a focal point in the communication with other teams and areas of the company.
  • Serve as a technical reference to the team and gain recognition as such across the company.
  • Mentor and guide other engineers, fostering a culture of technical excellence, ownership, and collaboration.
  • Live the mission: inspire and empower others by genuinely caring for your own wellbeing and your colleagues. Bring wellbeing to the forefront of work, and create a supportive environment where everyone feels comfortable taking care of themselves, taking time off, and finding work-life balance.
Main requirements WHO YOU ARE

  • A specialist frontend software engineer with strong expertise in React and React Native , along with a solid understanding of related technologies.
  • Experienced in distributed systems and modern system designs, including cloud environments, CI/CD pipelines, Backend for Frontend (BFFs), Micro Frontends, as well as web and mobile applications.
  • Skilled in designing and developing complex modern mobile and web applications.
  • Experienced with RESTful and GraphQL services, collaborating with backend teams to create mockups, define payloads, and follow HTTP best practices.
  • Capable of architecting large-scale, multi-tier web applications.
  • A team player who thrives in collaborative environments, providing mentorship to junior colleagues and actively seeking support from peers.
  • An effective communicator, both written and verbal, able to clearly articulate ideas across cultures and geographies in both Portuguese and English.
  • A professional with strong desire for learning and self-development, holding a bachelor’s degree in computer science or possessing equivalent professional experience.

We recognize that individuals approach job applications differently. We strongly encourage all aspiring applicants to go for it, even if they don't match the job description 100%. We welcome your application and will be delighted to explore if you could be a great fit for our team. For this specific role, please note that prior experience in React and React Native are mandatory requirement. Benefits & Perks WHAT WE OFFER YOU  We're a wellness company that is committed to the health and well-being of our employees. Our flexible program allows you to customize your benefits, according to your needs!
Our benefits include:
WELLNESS: Health, dental, and life insurance.
FLEXIBLE WORK: At Wellhub, flexibility fosters a happier, healthier, and more productive work environment for everyone. As a Flexible First company, we offer two work model options: flexible hybrid and full remote, and make the office a place for collaboration, community, and team building. The model for this role can be discussed with your recruiter and hiring manager. We offer all employees a home office stipend and a monthly flexible work allowance to help cover the costs of working from home.
FLEXIBLE SCHEDULE: Wellhubbers and their leaders can make the best decisions for their scope. This includes flexibility to adjust their working hours based on their personal schedule, time zone, and business needs.
WELLHUB: We believe in our mission and encourage our employees and their families to take care of their wellbeing too. Access onsite gyms and fitness studios, digital fitness programs, and online wellness resources for meditation, nutrition, mental health support, and more. You will receive the Gold plan at no cost, and other premium plans will be significantly discounted.
PAID TIME OFF: We know how important it is that our employees take time away from work to recharge. 
Vacations after 6 months and 3 days off per year + 1 day off for each year of tenure (up to 5 additional days) + extra day off for your birthday.
PAID PARENTAL LEAVE: Welcoming a new child is one of the most special moments in your life and we want our employees to take the time to be present and enjoy their growing family. We offer 100% paid parental leave to all new parents and extended maternity leave
CAREER GROWTH: Outstanding opportunities for personal and career growth. That means we maintain a growth mindset in everything we do and invest deeply in employee development.
CULTURE: An exciting and supportive atmosphere with ambitious people from around the world! You’ll partner with global colleagues and share in the success of a high-growth technology company disrupting the health and wellness space. Our value-based culture of trust, flexibility, and integrity makes this possible every day.

Diversity, Equity, and Belonging at Wellhub We aim to create a collaborative, supportive, and inclusive space where everyone knows they belong.
Wellhub is committed to creating a diverse work environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, non-disqualifying physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status, or any other basis covered by appropriate law.

title: Tech Lead Frontend Software Engineer | Explore Team
description:
At Wellhub (Permanent), in Brazil
Expires at:
Remote policy: Full remote Your wellbeing matters. Join a company that cares.

GET TO KNOW US
Wellhub (formerly Gympass) is a corporate wellness platform that connects employees to the best partners for fitness, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition, and sleep, all included in one subscription designed to cost less than each individual partner. Founded in 2012 and headquartered in NYC, we have a growing global team in 11 countries. At Wellhub, you have the opportunity to build a career in a high-growth tech company that places wellbeing at the foundation of its culture, and contribute to making every company a wellness company.
THE OPPORTUNITY
We are hiring a Tech Lead Frontend Software Engineer for our Explore team in Brazil ! This is a Remote – Brazil position, meaning you can work from anywhere within the country. Please note that this role is only open to candidates in Brazil.
As a Tech Lead, you will oversee a team of software engineers and ensure the pace and quality of their technical deliveries. Your team will see you as a technical reference, and you should expect to code some key features, review pull requests, and actively participate in all the architectural decisions of the squad. You will collaborate closely with the Product Manager in order to evaluate the feasibility of tasks, choose the best strategy for assigning and splitting user stories and prioritize engineering issues and technical debts. You need to make sure that agile ceremonies are running effectively and watch out for any process bottlenecks. 
It is also expected of you to have a sharp strategic mindset, questioning the product team and stakeholders about the scope and timing of features, balancing the complexity and the cost of opportunity of deliveries, while fostering a culture of innovation in your team. In addition, you're expected to perform management tasks such as mentoring, facilitating, and conducting regular one-on-ones with the members of your team, making sure that they are constantly challenged, recognized, engaged, and that they keep improving their technical skills over time. You should assess their performance regularly and draw the best plan for their career.
  YOUR IMPACT

  • Develop, often in pair programming, parts of the features (expected around 30% to 50% of your time);
  • Account for systems reliability and monitoring, fostering the ownership in the team, keeping the team's SLOs under budget, as well as ensuring the team is on top of our flows monitoring;
  • Manage technical debts and engineering backlog;
  • Set up experiments to test improvements.
  • Ensure successful deliveries and promote the long-term technical health of our journeys.
  • Ensure a high bar on code quality standards, making sure devs are proud of their work;
  • Work in a collaborative and agile environment that prioritizes people over process and is laser-focused on productivity;
  • Take part in incident resolution and troubleshooting in production.
  • Help the engineering team grow on their career;
  • Live the mission: inspire and empower others by genuinely caring for your own wellbeing and your colleagues. Bring wellbeing to the forefront of work, and create a supportive environment where everyone feels comfortable taking care of themselves, taking time off, and finding work-life balance.
Main requirements WHO YOU ARE
  • You have experience in mobile development.
  • You have experience working with modern agile product development teams.
  • You are versed in working with TypeScript;
  • You have experience with React Native.
  • You are familiar with working with BFF;
  • You have analytical, problem-solving, and critical thinking skills;
  • You have well-developed communication skills and are capable of clearly articulating ideas when communicating to groups, including multidisciplinary teams located in several countries with different cultures;
  • You can articulate ideas clearly when speaking to groups in English.
  • You can perform management tasks such as mentoring, facilitating and conducting regular one-on-ones with the members of your team, making sure that they are constantly challenged, engaged, and improving their skills.
We recognize that individuals approach job applications differently. We strongly encourage all aspiring applicants to go for it, even if they don't match the job description 100%. We welcome your application and will be delighted to explore if you could be a great fit for our team. For this specific role, please note that prior experience as a Frontend Engineer and Tech Lead positions are mandatory requirements. Nice to have The following would be considered a plus:
  • Experience with the React ecosystem;
  • Experience with GraphQL;
  • Experience with Firebase ecosystem (Custom events, remote configs, Crashlytics);
  • Experience with Design System and common UX patterns;
  • Experience with accessibility (mobile).
Benefits & Perks WHAT WE OFFER YOU  We're a wellness company that is committed to the health and well-being of our employees. Our flexible program allows you to customize your benefits, according to your needs!
Our benefits include:
WELLNESS: Health, dental, and life insurance.
FLEXIBLE WORK: At Wellhub, flexibility fosters a happier, healthier, and more productive work environment for everyone. title: Senior Engineering Manager | CXTech
description:
At Wellhub (Permanent), in Multiple Locations
Expires at:
Remote policy: Full remote We are hiring a Senior Engineering Manager to our CXTech team in Brazil or Portugal ! 
As a Senior Engineering Manager you will lead three teams that develop solutions to be used by the Customer Experience team, guiding tech leads and fostering an environment of technical excellence and strong team dynamics. Your role is pivotal in shaping the engineering and product development landscapes, ensuring that our technical strategies align seamlessly with business objectives.
CXTech uses artificial intelligence to build scalable self-service support solutions to decrease ticket volume and streamline complex issue resolution for greater efficiency and productivity.
The CXTech team is responsible for developing and maintaining the entire CX ecosystem such as Help Center, online and offline support, internal customer management system and customer support system( Zendesk). The main KPIs are digital deflection, overall contact rate, human agent productivity, and chatbot CSAT.
YOUR IMPACT
  • Guide the team with AI solutions to increase deflection and improve customer support efficiency;
  • Oversee, mentor, and guide one or multiple engineering teams and their leads to deliver on large-scale projects with high complexity, ensuring alignment with company goals and strategic priorities;
  • Partner with senior leadership to influence and drive engineering and product roadmaps, focusing on scalability, innovation, and business value. You'll have a direct impact on company-wide decisions;
  • Foster engineering excellence by advancing best practices, improving development processes, and ensuring the technical vision remains relevant and actionable. You’ll champion the use of cutting-edge technologies and techniques to maintain a competitive edge;
  • Work closely with product, operations, and business stakeholders to ensure engineering outputs drive measurable business success, such as user growth, operational efficiency, and revenue generation;
  • Cultivate a high-performing culture by mentoring engineering leaders and teams, ensuring continuous professional development and creating a clear path for career progression;
  • Ensure critical systems and services operate at high availability and scalability while remaining adaptable to new business models and client needs;
  • Work in a collaborative and agile environment that prioritizes people over process and is laser-focused on productivity;
  • Drive data-driven decision-making processes, ensuring that metrics and KPIs guide engineering priorities and resource allocation;
  • Live the mission: inspire and empower others by genuinely caring for your own wellbeing and your colleagues. Bring wellbeing to the forefront of work, and create a supportive environment where everyone feels comfortable taking care of themselves, taking time off, and finding work-life wellness.
Main requirements WHO YOU ARE

  • You are a technical professional with a passion for software and product development;
  • You are accountable for your decisions and possess a high level of ownership over the products you are delivering.
  • Experienced in managing managers (leads), as well as guiding multiple teams of software engineers across different locations, helping them align with business goals;
  • Experienced in designing and developing complex modern web applications;
  • You excel in mentoring engineering leads and their teams, helping them grow their leadership and technical skills. You are proactive in driving technical growth, code quality, and operational excellence across multiple teams;
  • You have excellent communication skills, able to bridge the gap between technical and non-technical stakeholders, and align cross-functional teams towards common objectives;
  • Experienced in applying computer science fundamentals: data structures, algorithm design, problem-solving, and complexity analysis;
  • You have a deep understanding of systems and can actively troubleshoot issues, identify root causes, and work with teams to quickly and efficiently resolve critical problems when needed. You balance strategic leadership with hands-on involvement in key technical challenges;
  • You need to be able to articulate ideas clearly when speaking to groups in English;
  • Solid experience dealing with event-driven architectures and message brokers such as RabbitMQ, KAFKA, ActiveMQ, etc and an in depth understanding of their use cases and pitfalls.

We recognize that individuals approach job applications differently. We strongly encourage all aspiring applicants to go for it, even if they don't match the job description 100%. We welcome your application and will be delighted to explore if you could be a great fit for our team. For this specific role, please note that prior experience in managing managers (leads), dealing with event-driven architectures and message brokers are mandatory requirements . title: Especialista de Recursos Humanos - HRBP
description:
Um retrato do seu dia
Como HRBP, você fará parte de um time de RH América Latina e será o parceiro estratégico das áreas de negócio, garantindo que as decisões relacionadas a pessoas estejam alinhadas à estratégia corporativa. No dia a dia, atuará como consultor de confiança para líderes, apoiando temas como gestão de talentos, sucessão, desenvolvimento, remuneração e engajamento. Além disso, será responsável por implementar políticas globais, promover um ambiente inclusivo e impulsionar uma cultura de alta performance.
Como você causará um impacto
  • Consultoria Estratégica: Atuar como parceiro estratégico para líderes seniores, influenciando a tomada de decisão e o desenho das estruturas das áreas de negócio.
  • Gestão de Ciclo de Gente: Orquestrar os processos de Pessoas (Performance, Sucessão, remuneração),garantindo a identificação e o desenvolvimento de talentos de alto potencial.
  • Implementação Global: Adaptar e executar políticas globais de RH, assegurando o alinhamento com a legislação local e a cultura organizacional.
  • Cultura e Inclusão: Impulsionar a agenda de Inclusão e Pertencimento (I&D), consolidando uma cultura de pertencimento e alta segurança psicológica.
  • Eficiência Organizacional: Monitorar KPIs de pessoas para propor melhorias em turnover, clima organizacional e produtividade.
O que você traz  
  • Formação superior em Administração, Psicologia, Recursos Humanos ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência sólida como HRBP ou consultor interno de RH, preferencialmente em empresas globais.
  • Conhecimento em gestão de talentos, sucessão, remuneração e legislação trabalhista.
  • Inglês avançado para interação com stakeholders internacionais. Espanhol avançado será um diferencial
  • Habilidade em influência, negociação e gestão de mudanças.
  • Desejável experiência com sistemas de RH e análise de indicadores.

Sobre a equipe 
Nosso time de Recursos Humanos no Brasil atua como parceiro estratégico do negócio, garantindo que as pessoas estejam no centro de tudo o que fazemos. Somos responsáveis por implementar políticas globais, apoiar líderes em decisões estratégicas de pessoas e promover um ambiente inclusivo e colaborativo. Trabalhamos em áreas como Relações Trabalhistas, Desenvolvimento de Talentos, Recrutamento, Remuneração e Serviços de RH, sempre com foco em inovação, compliance e excelência operacional. Juntos, impulsionamos a transformação e o crescimento sustentável da Siemens Energy.
Quem é a Siemens Energy?
Na Siemens Energy, somos mais do que apenas uma empresa de tecnologia de energia. Com ~100,000 funcionários dedicados em mais de 90 países, desenvolvemos os sistemas de energia do futuro, assegurando que a crescente demanda energética da comunidade global seja atendida de forma confiável e sustentável. As tecnologias criadas pelos nossos departamentos de pesquisa e pelas nossas fábricas impulsionam a transição energética e fornecem a base para um sexto da geração de eletricidade mundial.  Nossa equipe global está comprometida em tornar realidade a energia sustentável, confiável e acessível ultrapassando as barreiras do que é possível. Temos um legado de 150 anos de inovação que incentiva nossa busca por pessoas que ajudarão em nosso foco na descarbonização, em novas tecnologias e na transformação energética.  Saiba como você pode fazer a diferença na Siemens Energy:
Nosso compromisso com a diversidade
Para nossa sorte, não somos todos iguais. Através da diversidade geramos energia. Trabalhamos com inclusão e nossa energia criativa combinada é alimentada por mais de 130 nacionalidades. A Siemens Energy celebra o caráter, independentemente de origem étnica, sexo, idade, religião, identidade ou deficiência. Energizamos a sociedade, toda a sociedade, e não discriminamos por causa de nossas diferenças.
Benefícios
  • Programa de Participação nos Resultados (PPR)
  • Assistência Médica 
  • Assistência Odontológica
  • Seguro de Vida 
  • Auxílio Óptico: reembolso para aquisição de lentes corretivas e armações
  • Refeição: restaurante ou cartão refeição a depender da modalidade e localidade de trabalho
  • Previdência Privada
  • Estacionamento/Veículo Fretado/Vale Transporte (a depender da localidade)
  • Gympass
  • Auxílio creche ou babá para colaboradoras mães
  • Posto de atendimento bancário ou caixas eletrônicos
  • Ambulatório médico com equipe médica e enfermagem, e outras especialidades
  • Convênio com farmácia nas principais cidades brasileiras
  • Atendimento de serviço social
  • Massoterapia 
  • Licença maternidade/paternidade/parental estendidas

title: \"Consultor Funcional SAP ACM #993332\"
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

A Dexian incentiva a DIVERSIDADE. Nossas oportunidades também estão disponíveis para candidatura de pessoas com deficiência e reabilitados.


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

  • Conduzir o entendimento funcional detalhado junto aos Business Partners (BPs), garantindo total coerência entre a necessidade real do negócio e a solução sistêmica proposta;
  • Converter Histórias de Usuário (HU) em especificações funcionais (FS) e desenhos técnicos (DS) detalhados, contemplando regras de negócio, tratativa de exceções e validações complexas;
  • Elaborar fluxogramas de processos (AS-IS / TO-BE) e modelos em notação BPMN para suportar o entendimento end-to-end das cadeias de valor;
  • Mapear de forma exaustiva as integrações, dados mestres, dependências entre objetos SAP e impactos cruzados entre módulos;
  • Atuar em colaboração direta com Especialistas SAP (ABAP/Integration) e Liderança Técnica para validar a viabilidade e performance das soluções desenhadas;
  • Criar cenários de testes funcionais abrangentes e suportar a execução de testes integrados, smoke tests e homologação de usuário (UAT);
  • Acompanhar o ciclo de vida da entrega, validando correções, parametrizações e garantindo a qualidade dos transportes até o ambiente de Produção (PRD);
  • Produzir e manter documentação funcional clara, estruturada e aderente aos padrões de governança do programa;
  • Apoiar a governança funcional da TI, zelando pela manutenção de templates, boas práticas e padronização da documentação.


O que você precisa ter

  • Vivência sólida em projetos de implementação ou sustentação de SAP S/4HANA, especificamente no módulo ACM (Agricultural Contract Management);
  • Experiência comprovada na elaboração de Especificações Funcionais (FS) e Técnicas (DS);
  • Conhecimento prático de processos empresariais end-to-end (OTC, P2P, Logística e Integração com Balança/Armazenagem);
  • Domínio de SAP S/4HANA (Módulo ACM);
  • Interpretação de requisitos em formato BDD (Given/When/Then);
  • Modelagem de processos (BPMN) e ferramentas de diagramação;
  • Conhecimento sobre arquitetura de integração SAP (APIs, IDOCs) e sistemas satélites;
  • Metodologia de projeto SAP Activate.


Será um destaque seu perfil com

  • Experiência funcional híbrida (conhecimento em módulos correlatos como SD, MM ou TM);
  • Conhecimento profundo das especificidades do setor de Agronegócio (Commodities, Originação, Fixação);
  • Inglês técnico para leitura de manuais e notas SAP.


Onde você vai trabalhar?

No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

A Dexian incentiva a DIVERSIDADE. Nossas oportunidades também estão disponíveis para candidatura de pessoas com deficiência e reabilitados.


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

  • Conduzir o entendimento funcional detalhado junto aos Business Partners (BPs), garantindo total coerência entre a necessidade real do negócio e a solução sistêmica proposta;
  • Converter Histórias de Usuário (HU) em especificações funcionais (FS) e desenhos técnicos (DS) detalhados, contemplando regras de negócio, tratativa de exceções e validações complexas;
  • Elaborar fluxogramas de processos (AS-IS / TO-BE) e modelos em notação BPMN para suportar o entendimento end-to-end das cadeias de valor;
  • Mapear de forma exaustiva as integrações, dados mestres, dependências entre objetos SAP e impactos cruzados entre módulos;
  • Atuar em colaboração direta com Especialistas SAP (ABAP/Integration) e Liderança Técnica para validar a viabilidade e performance das soluções desenhadas;
  • Criar cenários de testes funcionais abrangentes e suportar a execução de testes integrados, smoke tests e homologação de usuário (UAT);
  • Acompanhar o ciclo de vida da entrega, validando correções, parametrizações e garantindo a qualidade dos transportes até o ambiente de Produção (PRD);
  • Produzir e manter documentação funcional clara, estruturada e aderente aos padrões de governança do programa;
  • Apoiar a governança funcional da TI, zelando pela manutenção de templates, boas práticas e padronização da documentação.


O que você precisa ter

  • Vivência sólida em projetos de implementação ou sustentação de SAP S/4HANA, especificamente no módulo ACM (Agricultural Contract Management);
  • Experiência comprovada na elaboração de Especificações Funcionais (FS) e Técnicas (DS);
  • Conhecimento prático de processos empresariais end-to-end (OTC, P2P, Logística e Integração com Balança/Armazenagem);
  • Domínio de SAP S/4HANA (Módulo ACM);
  • Interpretação de requisitos em formato BDD (Given/When/Then);
  • Modelagem de processos (BPMN) e ferramentas de diagramação;
  • Conhecimento sobre arquitetura de integração SAP (APIs, IDOCs) e sistemas satélites;
  • Metodologia de projeto SAP Activate.


Será um destaque seu perfil com

  • Experiência funcional híbrida (conhecimento em módulos correlatos como SD, MM ou TM);
  • Conhecimento profundo das especificidades do setor de Agronegócio (Commodities, Originação, Fixação);
  • Inglês técnico para leitura de manuais e notas SAP.


Onde você vai trabalhar?

No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office.

title: Project Manager
description:
Project Manager – Technical Learning Programs


  • Location : Brazil (Remote)
  • Employment type: PJ (Pessoa Jurídica) Contract | Monthly Invoicing
  • Start : ASAP | Contract through December 2026


About SureSkills

SureSkills is a global leader in technical learning and enablement, partnering with major technology organisations including Google Cloud. We design and deliver advanced cloud training programs, hands-on labs, certification pathways, and scalable technical enablement initiatives worldwide.


About the Role

This is a cross-functional, delivery-focused role supporting high-impact Google-related initiatives.


You will work closely with internal business owners across:


  • Content Development (technical workshops)
  • Technical Lab Support (hands-on learning environments)
  • Budget management and reporting


This is structured project leadership — not direct people management. The role also involves regular interaction with stakeholders at Google, requiring clear communication, structured updates, and strong alignment management.


Ideal Profile

  • 5–10 years’ experience in project management
  • Experience delivering technical, digital, or learning programs
  • Strong cross-functional coordination skills
  • Comfortable engaging enterprise stakeholders
  • Strong written and spoken English
  • Able to operate independently in a PJ contractor model


Backgrounds That Fit Well

  • Learning / Enablement Project Manager (technical programs)
  • Content Development PM for complex digital initiatives
  • Program Manager in consulting or partner ecosystems
  • Technical PM in cloud, SaaS, or infrastructure environments


What You’ll Do

Program Planning & Coordination

  • Build structured project plans and define milestones
  • Manage timelines, risks, and dependencies
  • Ensure alignment across multiple workstreams

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Coordinate lab and content development initiatives
  • Facilitate alignment meetings
  • Proactively resolve blockers

Google Stakeholder Engagement

  • Provide structured status updates
  • Clarify evolving requirements
  • Support delivery alignment between SureSkills and Google

Delivery Oversight

  • Monitor readiness of lab environments and learning assets
  • Coordinate QA and validation cycles
  • Support smooth program launch and rollout

Process Improvement

  • Contribute to scalable, repeatable delivery frameworks
  • Improve reporting, documentation, and visibility


This is a high-visibility role with direct exposure to Google stakeholders and global cloud initiatives.


If you’re a structured, delivery-driven PM who enjoys working at the intersection of technology and learning, we’d love to hear from you

Você fará parte de um time em uma empresa inovadora, especializada em desenvolver soluções tecnológicas para o segmento de serviços, contribuindo para a transformação digital desse setor.

Experiencia com desenvolvimento com Ruby on Rails (versão 6 ou superior)

PostgreSQL

Sidekiq Redis RSpec ou Minitest

Git

Perfil colaborativo, proativo e orientado à entrega de valor

Atuar no desenvolvimento e manutenção de aplicações escaláveis em Ruby on Rails

Trabalhar em conjunto para entrega de soluções robustas e eficientes

Escrever testes e garantir a qualidade do código


Por que essa vaga pode ser ideal pra você?

Ambiente de aprendizado contínuo e espaço para crescimento

Time comprometido com excelência técnica

Cultura de feedback

Autonomia e respeito

title: Data Annotation & Content Writing Specialist – AI Training
description:
About the Role:


We are looking for detail-oriented and language-savvy professionals to support AI training through high-quality data annotation, content writing, and linguistic evaluation. This role is ideal for individuals who enjoy working with language, structured data, and written content, and who are interested in contributing to the development of AI and NLP systems. You will play a key role in improving model accuracy, clarity, and usability by creating, reviewing, and annotating language data.


Job Title: Data Annotation & Content Writing Specialist – AI Training


Experience Level: Bachelor’s / Master’s degree in any discipline (Linguistics, English, Journalism, Mass Communication, or related fields preferred)


Key Responsibilities:

  • Annotate and label text, audio, or image data according to defined project guidelines.
  • Create, rewrite, and edit content such as prompts, responses, summaries, or examples for AI training.
  • Review and evaluate AI-generated outputs for accuracy, relevance, grammar, tone, and clarity.
  • Identify and flag issues related to ambiguity, bias, factual errors, or inconsistencies in content.
  • Perform quality assurance (QA) checks to ensure annotated and written data meets required standards.
  • Follow detailed instructions and annotation schemas with high attention to detail.
  • Collaborate with internal teams to improve annotation guidelines and content quality.


Qualifications:

  • Strong written English skills with good grammar, vocabulary, and sentence structure.
  • Ability to understand and follow detailed guidelines and workflows.
  • Experience in data annotation, content writing, editing, or reviewing is an advantage.
  • Familiarity with AI, NLP, or language models is a plus but not mandatory.
  • High attention to detail, consistency, and quality.
  • Ability to work independently and meet deadlines.
